We must return these elections to the people -- all the people -- and not just the marginal few in a handful of states that are toss-ups. The popular vote determining the president is the best way to do that, not an outdated compromise from tired constitutional delegates.
RUSH $35 or more right now to make the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact a reality and end the Electoral College forever! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=091124_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091124_3&amount=25]
Whenever we talk about the Electoral College, Friend, we get a bunch of replies complaining that, if we dropped the Electoral College, the candidates would only go a handful of big states. Well, check out this map the Associated Press put together . It's the cities that have seen campaign stops from the 2024 presidential candidates:
AP map of 2024 presidential campaign stops [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/AP_CampaignMap2024.png]
Not a great look, is it? Eight or so states with more than two stops, a handful more with one or two, and more than half the states with zero . And those big states? Already on this list, with California, Texas, Florida, and New York all having multiple stops.
This map is further evidence that this dated system -- one that is supposed to bring fairness to the process of electing our national executive -- is broken, driving the candidates into a handful of states while more than half the country likely won't see a presidential candidate ever.
Every day, more pro-democracy activists join our movement. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can today and help us ditch the Electoral College? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=091124_3&amount=35]

We have an answer and an alternative to the Electoral College that will work without a constitutional amendment: The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.
The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 16 states plus DC have already joined, accounting for 206 electoral votes of the 270 needed to win. Several more states have bills moving through their state legislatures to potentially join.
Put us over the top in the other states we need to join to end the Electoral College forever with $35 or more today! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=091124_3&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Hey folks, it’s Jon. Can I be real with you?
**I’m no stranger to tough elections, but I’ve never run a race like this.** **[I’m in the fight of my life right now, and I could really use your help. I’ll explain more in a second, but first, will you make a split donation to my campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92633530/497778226/417329036?refcode=em20240911pm2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ddb246f0-9970-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGIyNDZmMC05OTcwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cxEb-GyWh2AMnVXEhZKQFhj6RXN3TpjwGXRIo_1_zAo=)**
Here’s two things I think you should know:

body:

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? I would not be reaching out were it not so important.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240911-4-900&t=3&akid=1907%2E135344%2EuEUuWU)

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended Labor Day picnics in Sioux City and Council Bluffs, spoke with the Pottawattamie County Democrats Women's Group in Council Bluffs, met with students at Northwestern College in Orange City, spoke with the Sioux County Democrats in Sioux Center, had a meet and greet in Lake City (where there are a lot more Melton yard signs than Feenstra ones, my goodness), and also was at the Clay County Fair Dem Party Booth before finishing the week speaking at the Fall Story Co Dems BBQ in Ames.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: The carbon capture pipelines have continued to be a heavy focus in the news and on the campaign trail. Since the Iowa Utilities Board approved eminent domain for Summit Carbon Solution's carbon capture pipelines in July, what was already an issue that fomented plenty of anger across the partisan divide escalated to a fever pitch.
I was arguably the first Iowa candidate to run against these pipelines, having run against them since early 2022, long before most Iowans knew what they were. This is one of the reasons my opponent Randy Feenstra's Republican primary challenger Kevin Virgil recently endorsed me, as he also sees how massive a threat these pipelines are to most Iowans.
What are my reasons for running against the pipelines? There's many:
1. The most notable one that most are upset about is the eminent domain abuse that these pipelines would require. I and certainly most Iowans would argue (roughly 80% of Iowans in numerous polls I've seen are against the use of eminent domain for these pipelines) that eminent domain should not be used for private gain like these pipelines would generate. This is not the intention of eminent domain per Iowa code. As of now, there are still hundreds of parcels of land (over 800 if I'm remembering correctly) along the original Summit pipeline route in which landowners have not agreed to voluntarily sell their land to Summit, so that's a lot of eminent domain that would occur for these pipelines to be laid.
2. Many are also very concerned about the public health risk of these pipelines, which are carrying a highly pressurized supercritical carbon product that if leaked via pipeline fracture can asphyxiate people very quickly. For more, you can google the Satartia, Mississippi 2020 carbon fracture pipeline fracture that sent dozens to the hospital. One EMS official there said if the wind was blowing differently that day, many would've died. I've attended a number of carbon capture pipeline protests and info sessions attended by county EMS personnel, and the message has been clear: We do not have the resources in rural Iowa to deal with such a fracture. Furthermore, Summit has recently asked for extensions from their original pipeline route, one of which would be laid less than a mile from Albert City, well within the area of impact if a fracture took place.
3. Many are also shocked to find out, per a recent assessment by the Sierra Club, that the Summit pipelines in Iowa may use close to 4 billion gallons of water a year, mostly from our deep bedrock aquifers that are not easily rechargeable. In a state that just came out of a multi-year drought that impacted all 99 of the state's counties, in a state where our DNR doesn't even know how much water is in our deep bedrock aquifers, that's a scary proposition.
4. Also, these pipelines are a waste of taxpayer money. The pipelines are being pushed because Bruce Rastetter, who is the founder of Summit Carbon Solutions, and his ilk, want federal tax credits that come from climate change mitigation programs. Here's the thing: these pipelines are a green washed scam that would not give us the carbon emissions reductions we need. There's different reasons for that. First, per the one data point we have of carbon sequestration tech being attached to an ethanol refinery plant, the ADM plant in Decatur, IL, the carbon emissions reductions was minimal because the energy required to convert the captured carbon on site to a transportable supercritical state is so much that it nullifies much of the carbon reduction per the carbon the tech captures. Second, these carbon sequestration tech projects usually end up taking the captured carbon and using it for Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR), forcing the last dregs of oil from fossil fuel beds that are almost depleted. The fact you can get federal tax credits from a climate change mitigation tax credit for that is illogical, and shows you what corporate money in our governance and politics does in eroding the value of these kinds of programs. If elected, I would work to close these loopholes in the federal tax credits program that are being exploited and that are leading to grift and false climate change solutions like these pipelines that are making more believe the concept of human-caused climate change is a hoax to grab tax credit money.
5. For the sake of time and space, there are a hodgepodge of other concerns as well, such as worries that insurance companies won't insure land the pipelines are on, that these pipelines will damage the topsoil layer that will result in less productive farmland (similar to the damage we've seen with oil pipelines that were laid over the last decade or so across Iowa), that the pipelines will make it harder to sell the land as they pose more threat to human and animal health than oil and natural gas pipelines, among other reasons. I could keep going. In a nutshell, these pipelines are a scam, and they're bad for Iowa, and would only enrich those that are already quite wealthy.

Good news though: Per the article I link to below, the South Dakota Supreme Court has recently found that eminent domain per their state code can not be used for these pipelines and is requiring a lower court to re-address the issue. Also, there's a referendum on the ballot there that voters will be able to use to declare these pipelines unlayable in the state, and these pipelines are quite unpopular up there too. This is relevant because the IUB approval here in Iowa for eminent domain is conditional on things such as approval being granted in the Dakotas as well, where these pipelines will also have to travel through.
The fight continues though, and I pledge to continue to be on the front lines of that resistance. I'll be attending some of the informational sessions Summit is required to put on across the district, as I've attended carbon capture protests throughout my two campaigns. Per below, one of them is coming up this Friday in Hancock Co. Meanwhile, my opponent Randy Feenstra continues to take Bruce Rastetter's money, continues to be a public supporter of these pipelines, and has yet to denounce the IUB decision granting eminent domain for these pipelines.
Our schedule for this week: On Monday 9/9, I spoke at the Fall gathering of the Franklin County Democrats in Hampton. On Tuesday, 9/10, I attended the Marshall County Democrats Debate Night Watch Party On Thursday 9/12, I'll be speaking at the NW Iowa Democrats Dinner in Le Mars, being held at 5:30 On Friday, 9/13, I'll attend the Summit information session regarding the carbon capture pipelines up in Garner in Hancock Co at noon before heading to a house party in the evening in State Center in Marshall Co On Saturday 9/14, I'll attend Ames Pride before going down to speak at the Polk County Democrats Steak Fry, the event beginning at 1. On Sunday, 9/15, I'll be at the Clay County Fair at the Dem Booth one more time from 11-1, and will then head home to take care of some campaign planning and logistics.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.sdpb.org/politics/2024-08-22/sd-supreme-court-reverses-lower-courts-decision-on-co2-classification
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

Hi there, **Just a few minutes ago I was on the debate stage with Gov. Cox.** I shared my vision for our state’s future and invited those who are tired of the divisiveness in politics and feel like their party no longer represents them, to join us — for the better. [**If you watched the debate and want to support our campaign for Governor, can you chip in what you can to help me continue to spread my message throughout Utah? >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/jm2CguUPn1kE) **So much preparation went into this moment because this November, we have a real chance to bring accountability and common-sense back to the Governor's office.** **_Cox's strategy to appease the far-right, legislative session after legislative session, has led to him aligning himself with the MAGA agenda._** Now, he wholeheartedly backs Donald Trump, giving him his endorsement and visiting the Arlington National Cemetery with him weeks ago. As you heard on the debate stage, another 4 years of Gov. Cox will see Utah continue its trajectory—where families say they are worse off financially than they were 12 months ago, where housing affordability continues to remain an issue, and where extremism takes a stronger hold on our State Legislature. **We can provide an alternative, and we can win this election.** [**With just 2 months left in this race, we need your support now more than ever. Can you make a grassroots contribution to our campaign tonight and help us hold Spencer Cox accountable?**](https://king4ut.us/l/MIYccuvpsmaF)

| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/8LQlWkFOAtda)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

THIS is his track record on reproductive rights.
#
Peter — Josh Hawley wants to control every aspect of our lives.
In fact, he’s made a whole career of it. **While Hawley is doing and saying everything he can to make you think otherwise, his views on reproductive freedom are still the most extreme of any politician serving in the U.S. Senate.**
His record proves it — and he’s the most vulnerable GOP incumbent because of it.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)**
**If Hawley is re-elected this November, he’ll have another six years to continue his control-obsessed crusade to rule over our bodies, families, and lives.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)
When the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in 2022 — an effort led by Hawley’s wife and supported by Hawley’s taxpayer-funded U.S. Senate office — Missouri was the first state to ban abortion, immediately enacting a dormant, exceptionless trigger ban.
More recently, Josh Hawley and his corrupt family business have been fighting to make sure abortion is outlawed in every state. The Supreme Court rejected their effort to ban the abortion pill mifepristone. But challenges in other states keep their fight alive.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)**
Hawley pioneered the legal arguments that led to closures of IVF clinics in Alabama, and that now threaten IVF access across the country. He voted against the Right to IVF Act, telling the media that it was a part of the “abortion agenda.”
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)
**Hawley even voted against BOTH the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act AND the Right to Contraception Act.** He’s justified voting against just about every aspect of reproductive healthcare because he really thinks it’s an abortion issue.
**Lucas Kunce is running to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate because he wants everyday Missourians to have the power to decide how to build their families.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)

**Josh Hawley is the most vulnerable GOP U.S. Senator with the most extreme record on reproductive freedom in the entire country.** This is our opportunity to beat him. But Lucas still urgently needs your help to get this message in front of voters every day between now and November 5:

He’s building this movement without a cent from corporate PACs, so he’s really counting on your support to get this message in front of voters.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71233?refcode=em20240911-7630&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7630%2E614464%2EqOX1MX)**

This Patriot Day, help support our heroes with this match offer
Hi USO Supporter,
Today, as we reflect on the significance of 9/11, we are reminded of the importance of service, sacrifice and unity. It's a day to honor those who have given so much and to support those who continue to serve our nation with courage.
Earlier today, we shared an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in honor of this day of remembrance. Our records show that you haven't yet taken advantage of the special match offer to support our heroes in uniform.
**[Will you please make a tax-deductible gift of $29 or more before this match expires this midnight?*](https://links.e.uso.)** The value of your gift will double to support our service members.
Here's a personalized link just for you: **[https://secure.uso.org/USOSupporter](https://links.e.uso.)**
[MATCH MY GIFT](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Thank you for always supporting our service members when it matters most.

Thank you,
Tabitha Glenn
Vice President, USO

~~ ONE ~~ TWO CARE PACKAGES NOW**](https://links.e.uso.)**
---
********
On Patriot Day, we remember those lost on Sept. 11 and thank the first responders and all who bravely saved lives. We also salute those who have since stepped up to protect and defend our country. The USO has stood alongside those who serve, but we rely on grateful Americans like you to help us support our brave heroes with critical programs like care packages.
**That 's why we wanted to share this 24-hour match offer with you right away: In honor of Patriot Day, the Jordan Family is matching all gifts until midnight tonight, up to a total of $25,000, to help the USO provide programs like care packages to service members around the world when they most need support.**
**[Will you please donate $29 or more now to have the value of your gift DOUBLED and show our brave heroes you're thinking of them on this difficult day?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[GIVE $10 TO HELP PROVIDE
~~ 1 ~~ 2 CARE PACKAGES](https://links.e.uso.)
---
[GIVE $30 TO HELP PROVIDE
~~ 3 ~~ 6 CARE PACKAGES**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/xdbZhG9dN~cK/RlE5bHRIOWI2dEVDcFBLMTY3aEU5TVI1UVJGOENDQ25pRWZVNFBzb2haY2VFZ0szUVQ3cTlyMHNXNjBSNm5lRXNlRWlLSWVOYjkxaDBLcHVYN0Iva3g3Z1VWNXNoWjZ1eVhjZ1UwQ3RzN2M9S0/QnlYVVV0dmhLVkVtcGdEUDdjOXAxdmhwRHkrZ3VYWlBFRkFZTTR1UWJYUjRzcVhkQXRxRE9talJpOGY2bFgvWGtVSWhkeHM1U21LK3RPYmZsMXZwR1MyRFRhK3RPVDFYS0)
---
[MATCH ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/G49Vhw-)
---
In the 23 years since that devastating day, thousands of brave Americans have enlisted in our military. They've made life-changing sacrifices, left behind loved ones, put their own lives and ambitions on hold and risked their lives to serve the country we all love. These heroes deserve our deepest support, and we're counting on you to take advantage of this opportunity to double your gift for them.
**[Please, will you give $29 today to have the value of your gift go twice as far for the service members who sacrifice so much for us each and every day?](https://links.e.uso.)**
Thanks for all you do to support our heroes.
--The USO

Friend,

I recently had a meeting with my finance director and the reality of the situation is a bit alarming.

After a fantastic effort from this team in August, grassroots fundraising has slowed down rapidly. That’s bad news, especially just after a quarter where our celebrity GOP opponent outraised us by $1.2 million. In 4 days we will hit our critical mid-month fundraising deadline, which will set the tone for our campaign's capacity to get out the vote with less than 55 days until the election. [**If you’re ready to give now without having to hear any more, you can chip in a split donation of $10 or more between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and my campaign right now.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/50957?t=7&akid=22039%2E4449941%2EtY8f7L) Otherwise, keep reading and I’ll tell you why our race is so important.

After being outraised last quarter, national Republicans have already committed $6 million to turning out the MAGA vote all across California. Not hitting my mid-month goal makes it that much harder to fight back.

Even further, this means that competitive down-ballot House races will have to work that much harder to win their elections, which can determine if we win back control of the House.

**I refuse to let this happen – but MAGA Republicans are seeing an opening. body:
A message on September 11th

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=9_11_never_forget&n=1)
---
Peter, On 9/11, we say never forget. Never forget those who were killed. Never forget how quickly Democrats and Republicans joined forces to shred our basic liberties, usher in a secretive regime of mass surveillance, unconstitutional detention, and torture, and drag us into illegal wars based on lies that have killed millions of people and squandered trillions of dollars. Never forget how millions of us stood up against the hijacking of our national grief to serve the neocons’ agenda of global military domination, and how we were ignored and demonized by the political elite. Never forget how our Muslim friends and neighbors were targeted, smeared, surveilled, and falsely charged with crimes in the name of "protecting our country". Never forget how “patriotism” was weaponized to dismantle the First Amendment and crack down on dissent, journalism, whistleblowers and activists to this day, as we face ongoing efforts to criminalize our freedom to protest injustice, war and genocide. Never forget how both Democrats and Republicans set us on this course to fascism, which has culminated in our government openly supporting genocide of the Palestinian people. Never forget that being a good American means having the courage to fight for justice - not “just following orders”. Only by standing up to resist both war parties can we reverse the descent into fascism and win a peaceful, just, livable future for our children.
---
**In solidarity and gratitude,** Team Stein/Ware 2024

23 years ago today, I woke up to a national tragedy. As disturbing as the news was that Tuesday morning, the still-unfolding [legacy](https://substack.com/redirect/9bcf0158-9273-45b2-9a8e-189c1dc2d0fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of that day has grown catastrophically [worse](https://substack.com/redirect/dfea7cc9-a59a-4d9c-94ee-32088304cc4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the decades since the 9/11 attacks. That night, I shaved my head before going to bed, having discovered during a pilgrimage to Mecca the previous summer that doing so was a ritual way for Muslims to shed our worldly attachments.
### A law student's alarm
My alarm at the time may have been driven by any number of things.
I was in law school at the time, and felt painfully aware that the [Supreme Court's 1944 ](https://substack.com/redirect/02492618-f9a5-49e4-a991-005ba330b8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Korematsu](https://substack.com/redirect/02492618-f9a5-49e4-a991-005ba330b8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ decision](https://substack.com/redirect/02492618-f9a5-49e4-a991-005ba330b8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) upheld indefinite military detention during a time of armed conflict. While the Bush administration had no formal authority to detain civilians outside the criminal legal process, the lack of formal authority didn't ultimately stop it from hatching a continuing mass surveillance scheme, or launching a torture program in violation of international law.
The Court is responsible for guarding the Constitution, and its abdication in _Korematsu_ effectively invited the Bush administration to consider military detention without trial. Ultimately, the administration did precisely that, while locating its detention facilities offshore in locations including Guantanamo Bay, Abu Ghraib, Bagram Air Force Base in Afghanistan, and [CIA "black sites"](https://substack.com/redirect/1491afe3-ba01-492d-ad58-e0bfb549ce01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) located in any number of countries.
I'd also recently watched [The Siege](https://substack.com/redirect/f6675415-ca86-4f72-bd34-84d2018e5e4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a 1998 film starring Denzel Washington, Annette Bening, and Bruce Willis depicting a horrific government response to terror attacks in the U.S. It was a compelling film even before the 9/11 attacks rendered it more or less prophetic.
As a student studying what passes for law in the U.S., I was aware at the time how precarious our so-called "rights" have always been when challenged by perceived exigency. And as a Muslim Pakistani-American immigrant, I figured--sadly, correctly--that I would likely fit a racial and religious profile.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! This post is public so feel free to share it._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=148792100&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4NzkyMTAwLCJpYXQiOjE3MjYxMDc5MTQsImV4cCI6MTcyODY5OTkxNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.qkfRw1hUynbkZNgFT0heeWDwT61Tedh3Iyhg2TI8r1U)
On the one hand, I felt surprised as the ensuing months unfolded at how relatively slowly Washington responded. On the other hand, I spent the next 20 years fighting [that response as it continued to expand](https://substack.com/redirect/9bcf0158-9273-45b2-9a8e-189c1dc2d0fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) beyond domestic surveillance to include executive secrecy, military detention, torture with impunity, and unprompted wars on multiple countries.
I spent those decades chasing a futile dream of guarding constitutional principles from political demagoguery that, during last night's presidential debate, ensconced itself in the mantle of bipartisan consensus.
### Neither Harris nor Trump support peace
[Last night's face-off](https://substack.com/redirect/ca48880a-bd89-47bc-95be-314cb8343986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) might be the only time that Kamala Harris and Donald Trump will ever debate each other. Having repeatedly [embarrassed](https://substack.com/redirect/c177250e-8d16-41fc-8298-4210cfac8119?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) himself on national television, Trump has [indicated his reluctance](https://substack.com/redirect/3dfdde05-aed1-4194-97b1-9699c1e6ab28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to repeat the exercise, and with good reason: he has no business running for the White House in the first place, especially given his multiple impeachments and criminal convictions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1ad6bbec-3cfd-4f30-b436-d2ef7f2d58a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But while any number of observers have sang [praise](https://substack.com/redirect/2a14f4f9-34da-4b9d-955b-c32cc97b4f93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Vice President Harris in the wake of last night's debate, most have shied away from observing an elephant in the room: a disturbing imperial consensus uniting her and Trump.
Harris and Trump went so far as to compete over which of them would be more brutally efficient in demonizing immigrants, and which would be more belligerent towards other countries. Neither pledged to guard the principles that once united America before they were casually discarded in the response to the 9/11 terror attacks.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..hZCjd-zih15KM_OMIZu0j2OKSfb9LxvspxkvlXorB1A?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148792100)
Harris suggested at one point that the war on Gaza started on October 10, 2023--conveniently forgetting the 75 years of military occupation and human rights abuses that preceded it and prompted the events of that day. Both she and Trump would effectively enable Netanyahu's [self-serving](https://substack.com/redirect/496f1bee-f5e2-458e-9dad-352a0178afb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) genocide to continue.
Harris and Trump differed over where to target their belligerence--Harris would prefer to target Russia, while Trump seems to prefer focusing on China--but a vision of [unrestrained](https://substack.com/redirect/91244fa4-0409-4e89-81f7-fec59a5f8a14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) American [militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/46db71ae-3949-4546-afae-3a317b4e1963?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) standing above international law outrageously unites them. Neither of them appears willing to champion a rational or humane foreign policy, while both of them insist on demonizing the migrant workers and families responsible for America's prosperity.
It is disappointing to witness yet again how little this country ever seems to learn from even its own history. While professional journalists continue to fail America, [bipartisan fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/886fe97d-dbb8-46e5-a240-f09c4d1c27e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) continues to consolidate. Meanwhile, voters unwilling to support imperialism enjoy a [better option](https://substack.com/redirect/5bd4bd21-fb63-4524-b4ea-1499aeeeefdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than either of the candidates who debated last night.

| Dear ,
Last night, I had the privilege of attending the Salt Lake County Democrats Presidential Debate Watch Party at the Green Pig Pub. It was an amazing evening spent with local candidates and supporters like you, all energized by what’s at stake in this election.
During the debate, Vice President Kamala Harris made a bold and powerful pledge: _**“When Congress passes a bill to put back in place the protections of Roe v. Wade, as president I will proudly sign it into law.”**_ Former President Trump responded by saying Congress would never send her such a bill.
**But I refuse to accept that. We can make sure Congress does send that bill.**
I’m running to be the voice Utah needs in Washington. Send me to Congress, and I will fight to pass the bill that restores reproductive freedom to the women and girls of this country. Our future is at stake, and together, we can protect it.
Let’s make sure that when the time comes, President Harris will have that bill on her desk.
Thank you for standing with me in this fight. Your support is what makes it all possible.
---

It was an amazing evening spent with local candidates and supporters like you, all energized by what’s at stake in this election. During the debate, Vice President Kamala Harris made a bold and powerful pledge: “When Congress passes a bill to put back in place the protections of Roe v. Wade, as president I will proudly sign it into law.” Former President Trump responded by saying Congress would never send her such a bill. But I refuse to accept that. We can make sure Congress does send that bill. I’m running to be the voice Utah needs in Washington. body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Winning presidential debates is a Black job
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20Kamala%20debate.png]
Vice President Kamala Harris wasted no time in wiping the floor with Donald Trump during Tuesday's presidential debate. After all, Trump STILL cannot accept the fact he was 'fired by 81 million people' in November 2020.
WATCH the full debate here. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q0pQ5NwciBo]
Last night's abysmal and off-putting performance from Trump once again makes crystal clear what we already know: he's a racist, thin-skinned liar who will do and say anything to implement his extreme MAGA agenda.
With so much on the line for our communities this election, we're #TeamKamala all the way. Last night she shined — exposing 45 for the fraud he is, revealing the grave threat that is Project 2025, all while sharing with us all her bold vision for a future where ALL in our country have the opportunity to thrive, no matter our age, race, gender, or background.
MAKE SURE your friends and family have a plan to VOTE this election. [https://www.vote.org/]
Just as in 2020, it will take ALL of us to electorally kick Trump to the curb and secure a brighter tomorrow.
Amplifying the voices of residents fighting to stay in their homes
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Soap%20Factory%20San%20Antonio.jpg]
ORGANIZING PROGRESS: Tenants at Soap Factory Apartments in downtown San Antonio invited members of the City Council and representatives from developer Weston Urban to meet with them Monday evening in front of their apartment complex, where tenants shared how proposed financing from the City of San Antonio for a minor league baseball stadium will disrupt their lives and displace people from their homes.
San Antonio’s City Council is set to vote Thursday on public financing for this project that will use public funds to finance the construction of this stadium and entail the demolition of over 300 units of affordable housing to construct more high end housing.
This affordable downtown apartment complex would be unjustly leveled to make way for a minor league baseball stadium.
READ MORE about how TOP is standing in solidarity with these tenants, as they amplify their voices and fight against the demolishing of these apartments. [https://sanantonioreport.org/soap-factory-relocation-plan-weston-urban/]
TOP believes housing is a human right, and each and every resident of our state — regardless of their age, race, gender, preferred language, or economic status — deserves a safe, affordable, and secure place to call home.
A talk about transforming democracy comes to San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Democracy-Eventbrite.png]
Available this Saturday in San Antonio? Take part in an inspiring day of powerful talks, hands-on activities, and community discussions as part of the TED Democracy initiative, where participants will dive into how we can strengthen civic engagement and build a brighter future.
This San Antonio event is one of only 15 events worldwide selected for this initiative , so this is your chance to plug in to something bold on an international level!
Share the Facebook event here. [https://www.facebook.com/events/441292604950143]
TOP Tip: Fight MAGA racism. Donate to Haitian Bridge.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Haitian%20Bridge.jpg]
Sick and tired of MAGA's debunked lies and hate-fueled attacks against Haitian migrants like we are? It's all rooted in their anti-Black, white supremacist playbook. DONATE to groups like Haitian Bridge, who provide on-the-ground support to Haitian ayslum-seekers and work to uplift the Black migrant experience. [https://haitianbridgealliance.org/]

Ganar debates presidenciales es un 'Black job'
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20Kamala%20debate.png]
La Vicepresidenta Kamala Harris no perdió tiempo en limpiar el piso con Donald Trump durante el debate presidencial de anoche . Después de todo, Trump TODAVÍA no puede aceptar el hecho de que "81 millones de personas lo despidieron" en noviembre de 2020.
MIRA el debate completo aquí. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q0pQ5NwciBo]
La pésima y desagradable actuación de anoche de Trump vuelve a dejar en claro lo que ya sabemos: es un racista, un mentiroso susceptible que hará y dirá cualquier cosa para implementar su extrema agenda MAGA.
Con tanto en juego para nuestras comunidades en esta elección, somos #TeamKamala hasta el final. Anoche brilló: expuso a 45 como el fraude que es, reveló la grave amenaza que es el Proyecto 2025, todo mientras compartía con todos nosotros su audaz visión de un futuro en el que TODOS en nuestro país tengan la oportunidad de prosperar, sin importar nuestra edad, raza, género o antecedentes.
ASEGÚRESE de que sus amigos y familiares tengan un plan para VOTAR en esta elección. [https://www.vote.org/]
Al igual que en 2020, será necesario que TODOS participemos electoralmente para echar a Trump a la calle y asegurar un mañana mejor.
Amplificando las voces de los residentes que luchan por quedarse en sus hogares
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Soap%20Factory%20San%20Antonio.jpg]
ORGANIZANDO EL PROGRESO: Los inquilinos de Soap Factory Apartments en el centro de San Antonio invitaron a los miembros del Ayuntamiento y a los representantes del desarrollador Weston Urban a reunirse con ellos el lunes por la noche frente a su complejo de apartamentos, donde los inquilinos compartieron cómo la financiación propuesta por la Ciudad de San Antonio para un estadio de béisbol de ligas menores perturbará sus vidas y desplazará a las personas de sus hogares.
El Ayuntamiento de San Antonio está listo para votar este jueves sobre la financiación pública para este proyecto que utilizará fondos públicos para financiar la construcción de este estadio e implicará la demolición de más de 300 unidades de vivienda asequible para construir más viviendas de alta gama.
Este complejo de apartamentos asequibles en el centro de la ciudad sería injustamente arrasado para dar paso a un estadio de béisbol de ligas menores.
LEA MÁS sobre cómo TOP se solidariza con estos inquilinos, mientras amplifican sus voces y luchan contra la demolición de estos apartamentos. [https://sanantonioreport.org/soap-factory-relocation-plan-weston-urban/]
TOP cree que la vivienda es un derecho humano y que todos y cada uno de los residentes de nuestro estado, independientemente de su edad, raza, género, idioma preferido o situación económica, merecen un lugar seguro, asequible y protegido al que llamar hogar.
Una conversación sobre la transformación de la democracia llega a San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Democracy-Eventbrite.png]
¿Disponible este Sábado en San Antonio? Se parte de un día inspirador de conversaciones poderosas, actividades manuales y discusiones en comunidad pore parte de la iniciativa de TED Democracy donde los participantes navegarán en cómo podemos hacer más fuerte la participación cívica y construir un futuro más brillante.
Este evento en San Antonio es uno de solo 15 eventos a nivel mundial que fueron seleccionados para esta iniciativa, a si que está es tu oportunidad para que seas parte de algo audaz a un nivel internacional!
Comparte el evento de Facebook aquí. [https://www.facebook.com/events/441292604950143]
Consejos de TOP: Luche contra el racismo de MAGA. Done a Haitian Bridge.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Haitian%20Bridge.jpg]
¿Está harto de las mentiras desmentidas y los ataques llenos de odio de MAGA contra los Inmigrantes Haitianos como nosotros? Todo tiene su raíz en su manual de estrategias anti-negros y de supremacía blanca. DONE a grupos como Haitian Bridge, que brinda apoyo en el terreno a los solicitantes de asilo Haitanos y trabaja para mejorar la experiencia de los inmigrantes Negros. These lawsuits are _absolutely crucial_.

subject: Vote Your Faith
body:
Morality is on the ballot...

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdr7heua682irgo1lvba0uuu5mrine2jcrihqu48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
Friend, In the 2024 Election, it's not a matter of right versus left - it's a matter of right versus wrong. Morality is on the ballot... ...and the Institute for Faith & Culture is working hard to register thousands of new Christian voters before this year's election.
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqt6s2ag5v0ibteiu48huhi43quqj4vqt3im1qko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
_**[_**Friend, will you stand with the Institute for Faith & Culture ... and believers across America ... as you pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 Election?**_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgagmuvbnqjpmr6bj207g0qamk0tgqvggdb57l80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)**_
---
[**Sign the pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0mhqtg8jeb5us173sf3pf6erookblht1jcslueg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
God's hand is evident in the founding and shaping of America. Our Founding Fathers were profoundly influenced by biblical principles and our Judeo-Christian heritage is woven in every founding document. _Yet, the world wants Christians to believe that our faith has no place in the public square._ **You and I know the truth: the very heart of America is rooted in the timeless truths of Scripture!**
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zctgacsqqb7nbdd40ma6k9gl8dp8u8vni49p57n0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
_Above: The Institute for Faith & Culture prepares young believers for leadership every year. Let's pray for the next generation as they confront a hostile and secular world and bring the light of Christ to their campuses!_ Friend, today America's godly heritage is under attack - and the Institute for Faith & Culture, the non-profit ministry I'm proud to lead, is pushing back against the anti-Christian forces at play in America every day. In this important year, the Institute for Faith & Culture is registering thousands of voters and ensuring they understand their civic _and Biblical_ responsibility to vote... ...because life, religious liberty, and righteousness in our nation are too important to remain on the sidelines. _**[Friend, I hope you'll join us in igniting a NATIONWIDE revival in support of biblical values! Pledge today to VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 Election.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd4e3u3u9ifffe8kdjo6dn9bbna50dc0es5v30ho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)**_ When you sign the "Vote Your Faith" pledge, you're not just making a personal commitment - you're joining a movement of believers who are determined to be the salt and light our country so desperately needs. That's why my request today is so urgent ... and so important.
---
[**Sign the pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd887mt2u8v7joqtu1kg40i3blj28tgls1g26b90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
Secularism and moral relativism are eroding our shared values and our nation's culture. The next generation is leaving the faith in droves, the Church's influence on culture has waned, and a time of moral chaos and spiritual darkness has all but taken over our country. **America is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make in the coming years will have far-reaching consequences.** _[_By signing this special pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0spd5ms7f1e9scos4dtro6m8biu4rogppl5uqco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)_ , you are joining a growing movement of believers who refuse to be silent, who are determined to make a difference, and who are committed to advancing Christian principles in every area of our society. _**[_**Please stand with the Institute of Faith & Culture and THOUSANDS of believers across the country, as you pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 election.**_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi8t4n2aahr6ujb7tjd7e59ij122j3lspocugnv8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)**_ Thank you for your support. Please join me in praying ceaselessly for America's future.
---

name: Secure & Prosper
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.secureandprosper.-TuGAgP7Fg) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.secureandprosper.) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.secureandprosper.-IJ-r9vCxD5mMrpIgnrU-g) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. ArnnPresident, Hillsdale CollegePursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: FRC Action
subject: Sign the Petition: Urge presidential candidates to support Israel!
body:
As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now

| | | [](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zbu0vu4dc0r5b39c7eddjh8pg55tc8phh013q1h8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
|
---
Dear Friend, In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people. After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception." **As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now than ever that the United States stand with our ally. **Israel should be able to count on our support in its fight for its survival. **[Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zr8ti000dibbev5tj1uohjikednc992d17menmt8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)**
---
| | [**Sign the Pledge Now**](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z2u805ir18s6qpl0ugp257q9i25paapika96o2lo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
|
---
**To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:** It is of great importance that the next president of the United States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle East, Israel. For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel. Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas terrorists, this support has been put into question. Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a priority of the current chief executive and every presidential candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel. We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries. We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people and against alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise. We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.
---
|
---
[**Sign the Pledge**](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zq6hjeonf0p4jfaebqltlcur7snmr5qdq0kbqui0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3chj6aoj1c3h2bs)
---
God Bless, Jody Hice President, FRC Action

name: Robertson For Congress
subject: Reminder: Money in Politics
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robertson for Congress ***Mark Robertson retired from the Army
body: This may make you mad. Money in Politics By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District Hello Peter, Money can buy power, and power can corrupt. Nearly everyone agrees that there is too much money in politics. Both parties have contributed to the problem. Can anything be done to fix it? In this edition of the Monday Memo, I explain some issues, the results, and the solutions surrounding money in politics. Issue #1: Outside money buys influence with elected officials. The Problem: During this election cycle, less than 15% of donations to Dina Titus came from Nevadans; the remaining 85+ % came from Lobbyists, PACs, and individuals and organizations outside of Nevada. In contrast, 89% of contributions to my campaign came from the people of Nevada. The Results: Dina Titus doesn’t represent the people of her district. She represents the big-money interest of her wealthy donors. Titus is not alone in this regard; most elected officials receive significant donations from outside their districts. The Solution: We need to pass a law requiring candidates for public office to accept donations only from people who can vote for them. This will ensure that elected officials truly represent the people of their district. Issue #2: Elected officials use government spending to buy votes. The Problem: Whether it is canceling student debt, exempting tips from taxes, pork projects, or government grants to special interest groups, politicians have learned they can buy votes by borrowing, printing, and spending money we don’t have. This is a bipartisan problem with big spenders on both sides of the aisle. The Results: Our nation is more than $35,000,000,000,000 in debt and growing every minute. Each day, the federal government prints, borrows, and spends $5.2 billion more than it takes in. The interest alone is $2.6 billion a day. Dina Titus is not solely responsible for the debt; however, since she entered Congress, the national debt has nearly tripled. The Solution: We need to pass a law that says incumbents cannot run for reelection in any election cycle in which the government spent more money than it brought in. Issue #3: Elected officials spend too much time raising money and not enough serving constituents. The Problem: Members of Congress from each party are expected to raise money for their party and their reelection. Republican and Democrat parties own buildings on Capitol Hill where members go to “dial for dollars.” Plum committee assignments are doled to the members who raise the most money. The Results: Our congressional committees may not comprise the most qualified members but rather the most prolific fundraisers. For example, with 30 years of experience in the military and 20 years in financial services, you might think I would be selected for the House Armed Services or Financial Services Committees. However, these are highly sought-after committees, and thus, party leaders reserve these assignments for members who raise the most money. Committee chairmanships are doled out the same way. The Solution: We need to select committee members according to merit and qualifications. Fundraising should not play a role in committee selection. I’m running for Congress to change the direction our country is headed. We cannot afford to continue to spend money we don’t have. I will join other fiscal conservatives to fight the big spenders in both parties. Dina Titus has been part of the problem for far too long. It doesn’t make sense to expect the people who created these problems to now fix them. It is time for a change! clean_body: This may make you mad. Money in Politics By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District Hello Peter, Money can buy power, and power can corrupt. Nearly everyone agrees that there is too much money in politics. Both parties have contributed to the problem. Can anything be done to fix it? In this edition of the Monday Memo, I explain some issues, the results, and the solutions surrounding money in politics. Issue #1: Outside money buys influence with elected officials. The Problem: During this election cycle, less than 15% of donations to Dina Titus came from Nevadans; the remaining 85+ % came from Lobbyists, PACs, and individuals and organizations outside of Nevada. In contrast, 89% of contributions to my campaign came from the people of Nevada. The Results: Dina Titus doesn’t represent the people of her district. She represents the big-money interest of her wealthy donors. Titus is not alone in this regard; most elected officials receive significant donations from outside their districts. The Solution: We need to pass a law requiring candidates for public office to accept donations only from people who can vote for them. This will ensure that elected officials truly represent the people of their district. Issue #2: Elected officials use government spending to buy votes. The Problem: Whether it is canceling student debt, exempting tips from taxes, pork projects, or government grants to special interest groups, politicians have learned they can buy votes by borrowing, printing, and spending money we don’t have. This is a bipartisan problem with big spenders on both sides of the aisle. The Results: Our nation is more than $35,000,000,000,000 in debt and growing every minute. Each day, the federal government prints, borrows, and spends $5.2 billion more than it takes in. The interest alone is $2.6 billion a day. Dina Titus is not solely responsible for the debt; however, since she entered Congress, the national debt has nearly tripled. The Solution: We need to pass a law that says incumbents cannot run for reelection in any election cycle in which the government spent more money than it brought in. Issue #3: Elected officials spend too much time raising money and not enough serving constituents. The Problem: Members of Congress from each party are expected to raise money for their party and their reelection. Republican and Democrat parties own buildings on Capitol Hill where members go to “dial for dollars.” Plum committee assignments are doled to the members who raise the most money. The Results: Our congressional committees may not comprise the most qualified members but rather the most prolific fundraisers. For example, with 30 years of experience in the military and 20 years in financial services, you might think I would be selected for the House Armed Services or Financial Services Committees. However, these are highly sought-after committees, and thus, party leaders reserve these assignments for members who raise the most money. Committee chairmanships are doled out the same way. The Solution: We need to select committee members according to merit and qualifications. Fundraising should not play a role in committee selection. I’m running for Congress to change the direction our country is headed. We cannot afford to continue to spend money we don’t have. I will join other fiscal conservatives to fight the big spenders in both parties. Dina Titus has been part of the problem for far too long. It doesn’t make sense to expect the people who created these problems to now fix them. It is time for a change! Friend,

I need you **[to act right now to make a huge difference](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=afdf817edf614ea88a0aebe20cf15ff2&_e=EPg8P3MhvJG4i4kRX-QabclG9pEodWR1Z-t7dJ4Jhx6EVkEb8ItTfHKl2raLM7bZ4YEhiZd3lk9h53Z13g5mfMX8d_I2Gf9sVRu9wmrK2x1XtJyfJRJQH4LRYBRCEA_-QRbN6nGZuhEfDb4Pmy-otjaLZfcsXf2EtnI1bW079GJrwRU6sAGApf_J4pED8iuimimBfI8VP1a19IgDdSCEvmpBWeNBUVmMkJHXHbGQUUjVXodkPPovItxQhGlVqkxn0gTUal0G2IcsC7UEnhpXDmjsd9WzOYoePK9TT9ruAf5tdXVTEENhbhkBoYr3nh4zs0IH69sKTlicS91JGxlyh_3Lhv1Cbe5qjcmMS8BO57-JOLVeTCSKogbRqpxhFxM76L6Gl3DA_gd_4GVxIMAaoJCMSNGkh23oKkDHXA2_gxOsWSZaw79JRic2d_QAS4spHftgrZLrF1icApNpQXhPndpqGUCssmJ7ey8K6xcptZM%3D)** in a critical U.S. Senate race.

My friend and fellow Republican Senator, **[Deb Fischer](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=afdf817edf614ea88a0aebe20cf15ff2&_e=EPg8P3MhvJG4i4kRX-QabclG9pEodWR1Z-t7dJ4Jhx6EVkEb8ItTfHKl2raLM7bZ4YEhiZd3lk9h53Z13g5mfMX8d_I2Gf9sVRu9wmrK2x1XtJyfJRJQH4LRYBRCEA_-QRbN6nGZuhEfDb4Pmy-otjaLZfcsXf2EtnI1bW079GJrwRU6sAGApf_J4pED8iuimimBfI8VP1a19IgDdSCEvmpBWeNBUVmMkJHXHbGQUUjVXodkPPovItxQhGlVqkxn0gTUal0G2IcsC7UEnhpXDmjsd9WzOYoePK9TT9ruAf5tdXVTEENhbhkBoYr3nh4zs0IH69sKTlicS91JGxlyh1dOExlSTTMpxI75fxuv2-Pm5ZMbR5uiV2_UsA6OREKvr5-oZ7B9EZeJem5FHbbo8iEsuQsFxHJRYg64ztqdTigCU_xnnGsFN_HoL5Rd9TSqPm_YrpkZ8iSTwQq-ryCOXn0KVbej8RPfRVJcg7N4kJo%3D) **of Nebraska, is facing a tough challenge from Kamala Harris, Chuck Schumer, and the rest of the Democrats.

They know that if they defeat her, they'll keep the majority -- **[help us stop that from happening.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=afdf817edf614ea88a0aebe20cf15ff2&_e=EPg8P3MhvJG4i4kRX-QabclG9pEodWR1Z-t7dJ4Jhx6EVkEb8ItTfHKl2raLM7bZ4YEhiZd3lk9h53Z13g5mfMX8d_I2Gf9sVRu9wmrK2x1XtJyfJRJQH4LRYBRCEA_-QRbN6nGZuhEfDb4Pmy-otjaLZfcsXf2EtnI1bW079GJrwRU6sAGApf_J4pED8iuimimBfI8VP1a19IgDdSCEvmpBWeNBUVmMkJHXHbGQUUjVXodkPPovItxQhGlVqkxn0gTUal0G2IcsC7UEnhpXDmjsd9WzOYoePK9TT9ruAf5tdXVTEENhbhkBoYr3nh4zs0IH69sKTlicS91JGxlyh3u6UOLlpgz7OWMFktAG6ZBzSetHQKiL_uQOGZY9z7ehT3nEwUXY9jFTrdc-LIKKshSL2b41lLz03i50apEymqg6orin15gVwPTfNP1jW72FRQXvJQbU5iOP70Al6RBsJ5mEBnpbGuHKbd0aRBs9FbQ%3D)**

Friend, we can't afford to lose her in the Senate -- _and we can 't afford to lose the majority._

_**[Friend, to take back the majority, we need to flip two seats -- and we also have to hold the seats we already have, like Deb's.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=afdf817edf614ea88a0aebe20cf15ff2&_e=EPg8P3MhvJG4i4kRX-QabclG9pEodWR1Z-t7dJ4Jhx6EVkEb8ItTfHKl2raLM7bZ4YEhiZd3lk9h53Z13g5mfMX8d_I2Gf9sVRu9wmrK2x1XtJyfJRJQH4LRYBRCEA_-QRbN6nGZuhEfDb4Pmy-otjaLZfcsXf2EtnI1bW079GJrwRU6sAGApf_J4pED8iuimimBfI8VP1a19IgDdSCEvmpBWeNBUVmMkJHXHbGQUUjVXodkPPovItxQhGlVqkxn0gTUal0G2IcsC7UEnhpXDmjsd9WzOYoePK9TT9ruAf5tdXVTEENhbhkBoYr3nh4zs0IH69sKTlicS91JGxlyhwqROYcf2C1y8DGdw_cgIlkEf62JO8ZCn1uCjegPYMH5T4-bP5HmdIr-OziiiREiVOnmwTPD8hem-cn9apRhNfqoZ5UQ2Cx-uNuud1F8BpbwisjIDawz6eG5NIZuOYU6Af7QClxa4sGCDIgg1IR_QFo%3D)**_

Dear Friend, In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people. After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception." **As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now than ever that the United States stand with our ally. **Israel should be able to count on our support in its fight for its survival. **[Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cb41420d6cec4e76b5e13622e68640ac&_e=xeE19JfbQakrJGUrh2p2M7wxsVV1gkOe2NPth6J3TSMhKEy8jlyY5Crn1Wkd4Wo6j7Ib-F-7L72zgncIxbQTaplanJ-j9ubWVyJaxLJxHNtptuLVCMezGD8rnH2Cqwm7F_-fICdNaB7vdpv2jVmfc4sn5Lwt2AA-s9a72QFQ5N4FS2VLPY8J2lpvLxC7BLRWkhm1WW-pVC94A_SWRq-_Ow%3D%3D)**

**To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:** It is of great importance that the next president of the United States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle East, Israel. For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel. Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas terrorists, this support has been put into question. Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a priority of the current chief executive and every presidential candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel. We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries. We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people and against alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise. We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

Dear Friend, In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people. After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception." **As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now than ever that the United States stand with our ally. **Israel should be able to count on our support in its fight for its survival. **[Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6655950b6fa74cc0b256ef62d6d76296&_e=IdGe6Kt2ESI7aXGVV3_Qfa132ETF0mGZrAdCv1Cl4mipQE1lXuqqyMKtkSuHVYEOMN7z39YVxKnANzZa3GbP1Rxg4C3lzQI0XiqXNAkf1sa54PtpBb3jjV_wBmd43dhiuVC3SPMuP0RG-EubCixdbynBr0WSqLMsdgnxTen_EZ7h1zJVnSvITtR_oplAQxKTWXVBx3iau7HSYAV_JH3ohw%3D%3D)**

|

**To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:** It is of great importance that the next president of the United States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle East, Israel. For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel. Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas terrorists, this support has been put into question. Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a priority of the current chief executive and every presidential candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel. We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries. We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people and against alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise. We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

**A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF JD VANCE** Friend,

name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: Nonsense callout: Wokeness in NJ schools
body:
Peter, What’s going on in our schools? New Jersey has historically had some of the highest ranking schools in the country.
|
---
| Peter, What’s going on in our schools? New Jersey has historically had some of the highest ranking schools in the country. It’s something for us to be proud of! And yet, we’re currently facing so many pressing issues in our school system. There is a major [teacher’s shortage in important subjects](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/a111cd1ad96bc474764ddd240c5aca63/eJyNkMFOwzAQRP_F5xinThElt6qqqiilBwRnZJylMSS2tbsFQpV_x2kRXEDiPG9mZ_YoGLzxXDWiFO_8oXUhMoFgXXTgeRU8G3tS9eV8Vswy0Tn_ssFwiKI8_mr-Bk6uK73IBA8REnJ3u1zV1W7zsK12dSKjwXTjfzmL_CdnfbOstmIc_wyG3vH6NWWTKBkPMC1qXFrF99glvmWOVCrl4e0ZkGDog3cc8MKGXulcz1V-rfJi0uUZkI0jRmeZJLHrOvlkLEgGY1tASW1ANnsgaUhOJrJtCJ0cwKB8hL3zpFItEyP45uunNQzncuMnVMSBxA==) such as math and science. And children are still behind after our excessive COVID shutdown–our [test scores continue to be lower than pre-COVID and student absenteeism is at an all-time high.](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/a57d0edc477b1038eeb7919fc8476a49/eJyNkE1PwzAMhv9LzsuSfqCN3qZpmqqOHRCcUUiMmtE6UeKulGn_nWygnUBCsnywXz9-7RMjQIVUG1axD_rM84LNWABtvQWktUNS-trN78qsyGass_i-DW7wrDr9OnwTXKcWhZwxmjwkydPjat3U--3Lrt43SelVSDv-x1nK5Y2zeVjVO3Y-_wmG3tLmmNiRVRQGuFxkbLqKnkOX9C2Rj5UQ4zjO0QVqDxAiTHPtehHJhUkgjFGAGbQi61DkMi-FTFEIPPBIg7nAeW9jSi4Aj7p1ruPoRk6tQv4Kb5eydkdruFdokiUtFkV2Xy6zTMqFSDaV94Dm58cNTN9mz1-AcYWj) So, naturally, you would think our school boards, teachers unions, and government would be addressing these critical issues. Especially since Governor Murphy extended the education budget to [$44.7 MILLION](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/8b9ebc12a128fca76dbb76296243d681/eJyNkMFOwzAMht8l54a0aSem3qZpmqqOHRCcUZRYraFNosTdKFPfnTDQTiBx9vd__u0LI7DKUmNYzd7pQ8qSZSyARo9gaessKX2dylVVlEXGBrRv--Amz-rLr-EbcE3dlzJjNHtIyNPjZts2x_3LoTm2ifQqpB3_86zz9c2ze9g0B7Ysf4phRNqdkjuymsIEXxcZTFfRcxgS3xP5WAth4fwKIcI8Oovkwp12o5C5rES-EkUlOneCYF3g4xR8P_OInY18UGeONlU2YDg53sPgedS9cwM3GCmgpsgjANqOR1IEXKHheqIoUjnlfYr-fLaF-bvi8gl5y4RD) for the 2024-25 school year. But you would be wrong. **Our educators are focusing on bringing a woke agenda into our schools, often against parents’ wishes.** Phil Murphy signed a new law requiring a new “sexual orientation and gender identity” curriculum in K-12 schools. The curriculum pushes nonsense, for example [teaching first graders about gender roles and “gender identity,”](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/60a44b636cc3bb1fd356dbfefeb93883/eJyNkMFOwzAQRP_F5xinThBVblVVVVFKDwjOyHJWrUtiW-t12lDl3zEN6gkkzvNmdmavjMAqS3XLKnahTykLljEEbbwBS2tnSembKh_LRbHIWGfsxxZd9Ky6_mq-AzfXU1FmjEYPCXl9Wa2ber9939X7JpFeYbrxv5xlvrznbJ5X9Y5N05_B0BvaDCk7sIowwvei1qRV9IZd4o9EPlRCBDXACTDA-KBdL2QupchLEfQRvAmGe4TBwDlwC2c-g4FrNPYwchcJ1QFcnNUAF64jotGxi71IJZT3YNufDzYwzlWmL435e_I=) which outraged parents across the state. Can we please teach some math? That might help the NJEA–our state’s largest teachers union–figure out how to spend its ridiculous $136 million in teachers’ dues. Right now, they're misusing that money to send out mailers in support of their current president Sean Spiller’s candidacy for governor. Schools should be teaching students the basics–math, English, science, history–instead of pushing a woke political agenda. It’s just common sense! Unfortunately, common sense is something our Leftist school boards and governor seem to lack. That’s why those of us left with common sense MUST use our voices to hold them accountable for their actions. If that sounds like something you want to be a part of, then we’re your people. If you’re not already a member of the Common Sense Club, [you can join today for just $10/month!](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/a8b15878e9834f71912db8fc99e55e73/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnCVL-8JbiIhoHqLOsemQS-4Hu2Nk4X9v-6BTQTC3ed5neOcGhJJJymqI4ELXIAjBA4MV1xwlxUoSq57bYDadhBMPWi5PqVGdhuj2NfwBnqlFOPeAeo0O2W5WcZ6V6b7IytyRmhl34z_Pcrz8eJL1KitgGH6KUXBKzs5tISLT4aNRzV0r2pnW8Q2RtpHvV0oIJS26qdruMFLm6AsUBzS24dp3JqY1yvr9hhz7l2-4A7M2Zmo=) And if you’re already a member, we’re glad to have you! [Consider giving a little extra](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/797f076f3db8eddbef5fd2eb07ee87e7/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnC1Ti8KbRIRYHaLOsa0DLensso6Sif-97YO6FHSe531e3umAkQRxmkMMF76GYQQeWJTKKCSea2IhH9dwMg6iwINC0XlpdW0g7r6G38AjNY1mHnBr0CG7bTLP0s3ysEo3mSONsK7jP89s9PEs1km6gr7_KcZS8aJx7gpitjXeF-XKreK9LRx_YjZV7PtSl6WmQYVU4UAW9XFosWmGUvu5JsHoVMIYpPz1hwzbp7C_AQajZmE=) to help elevate the voice of common sense here in New Jersey. ## School Districts Respond To Uptick In Threats
School districts across the state are on alert for online threats, as many have reported an [alarming uptick in such incidents](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1urDAQRp_GdKDx4J9L4eI2dJs2JZrYZm3JYIQny-7bR9k-7adPR0fn87bcKJe83z9oi46fa13Ic37EZeol9qgW1QX3BWGSXXTSopFqNABdcv_AjgblaJQm0HZVwdsVlQegiNZglx0CKpgkStAG9YDBk0FSRNau2o5CQQyZ6zlwihyf1Nbyqo94Dr5uXXGJ-Whi_C9wFjhf1zVsr0Y77Vz3XH9PAuc9Xk3g3Oo3p_4NETjTydmXKHB-L33zqdbSczojcevlZDVq0MORju504bhyKbkZKxTcN8rlLcB_9Hg4_AkAAP__W3Bizg), forcing them to cancel classes and reschedule events. Although some social media posts have been [identified as hoaxes](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O3SAQRp8Gd3MFA_6hcJHG3aZNaY1hWCNhc2Um15u3j26klFt_3ynO-fWxflAu-fz8SQfP8pXqSkHyi1cPBgHd6ro4bzp60_FsRhyMs4PW3T77waRNbymNE5HzdsOo4xDCNKbe-uS6PKNGp71Bo_sB-wfGQAOSIxrH1I9WOc0xS70esrPwF7VU_tQXX49Qj67Mu8izKftD4aJwue_7cfLdbm7i3w-FC12SQ2GFy3tRuHD8HUhyPRUue73hydeR6YSNWj6hhb3WAjE3uXKQBoVu4DPVK_DBp8BOZywcwVmEVkOmAgfHTP9J2S8mUbj0xoIh2ojIAU3TAA6tgc1xAuTkp95Zjei7a47PO5eS2zAqpz8PyuWfnnxT-zXj3wAAAP__o9GC7A), authorities aren't taking any chances, and students in San Antonio, Donna, Kingsville, Austin, and other districts have been apprehended for making threats to inflict violence. | | | | | Hi Peter, Sherrod Brown here with an important update: A brand new poll shows that I’m losing ground to my GOP opponent in the most expensive Senate race in the country. My megamillionaire Republican opponent is gaining traction in Ohio — and fast. First, he self-funded $4.5 MILLION to his campaign. Then, Mitch McConnell’s super PACs made their biggest ad buy ever to plaster the airwaves in Ohio with attacks against me. Now we’re being outspent nearly 2 to 1 by outside special interest groups and my opponent is closing the gap. National Republicans are going all in to flip this seat red, and we can’t expect them to let up. Look, unlike my wealthy opponent, I can’t self-fund this campaign. I don’t have right-wing dark money groups or GOP megadonors who can spend a fortune to tilt the scales in my favor. Instead, I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help me fight back. We need your help to reach undecided voters, keep our ads on the air, and make sure Moreno’s attacks don’t go unanswered. [Will you split a donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign today to help me win the race that will determine Senate control? All eyes will be on how we respond to this polling update.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc88e9983-7748-4877-877b-aeacd0f0925c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

During his 2000 deposition, he pleaded the Fifth Amendment **75** times**.** And eventually, HCA pleaded guilty to **14** felonies **... all while Rick Scott got off scot-free.**
Instead of facing the consequences of his crimes against taxpayers and seniors, this launched the next phase of his career — from venture capital, to television, then urgent care clinics and pharmaceuticals, _then_ lobbying ...
**... And by the end of the 2000s, Scott's next career move was to make up the rules for himself entirely — first from the highest office in Florida and then the U.S. Senate.**
But what really gets me is that while regular Americans jump through hoops to receive medical care, draining their life savings to cover the bill, **Scott's fortune has only MULTIPLIED since his entry into "public service." **
Lucky for him, it only cost a _small $64 million fraction of his wealth _to buy his way into the Senate, where he's hard at work helping out his fellow fraudsters to this day.

# [If House Republicans shut down the government, stop paying their salaries!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf388eb56-ba13-4334-ae6d-04c8f357b6cb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
