---
| | | With a government shutdown looming, Republican Speaker of the House Mike Johnson is demanding a funding bill that includes a series of steps _ to make it harder to vote_. Republicans know they can't win a fair election, so they are trying to put up impediments that suppress the vote of those more likely to be Democrats. It's un-American, it's un-democratic, and they're willing to shut down the government if they don't get their way. And not surprisingly, Donald Trump is demanding House Republicans do it, regardless of how much damage it does to the country. Trump's cronies in Congress are willing to wreak havoc just to score political points and do Trump's bidding. **Well, if they can't do their job – representing and working for the American people – they shouldn't be paid. Not one penny, for as long as it takes.** They want to inflict pain on the people? Then let them be the first ones to feel it. body:
The cheapest way to run TV ads
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1908%2E135344%2ElO8Lq3)

Nobody likes it, but it’s the truth: TV advertising matters.
For a lot of voters, TV ads are the main way they learn about a political campaign. TV ads are also expensive, so TV ends up being a big part of most campaigns’ budget.
It’s doubly true in Michigan, where we have 11 media markets to reach and one of the most expensive — and crowded — media markets in the country in Detroit. In fact, no media market has seen more spending over the past few weeks than Detroit. If you’re in Michigan you’re probably being bombarded with constant attack ads.
As you can imagine, increased demand also leads to higher rates to purchase that TV advertising time. In the past month, rates for TV time have as much as tripled.
But not all TV ads are created equal. The FCC guarantees that _candidates_ can buy TV ads at the lowest rate during the 60 days before an election. Outside political groups, like super PACs, can be charged at the higher rates — as much as 3 to 5 times more than candidates. And we are now in that 60 day window.
That is why, when you are considering making a donation to advance Democrats’ hopes, your money will go the furthest when you contribute directly to a candidate like this one.
[**But even though we are able to buy TV ads at a lower rate than outside organizations, the flood of spending means that TV ads are still very expensive — even more than we were anticipating. So with that in mind, will you consider a $3 donation to our campaign, so that we can continue to reach the voters we need to win?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240912-1-900&t=2&akid=1908%2E135344%2ElO8Lq3)

Colorado conservatives face get-out-the-vote gap as election looms

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado conservatives face get-out-the-vote gap as election looms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
With just over 50 days remaining before a critical election, Colorado’s conservatives are grappling with a major organizational gap in their get-out-the-vote (GOTV) efforts. Internal battles over leadership have left the state party in limbo, while national political grassroots groups—typically a key source of support—are largely absent. Despite some outside help for two congressional races, the lack of coordinated efforts has left conservative activists and volunteers across Colorado asking: How can they make a difference with so little time left?
This disconnection comes at a frustrating moment for many conservative voters, who feel that Colorado’s increasingly blue voting trends have diminished the state’s role in national elections. Without a strong framework in place, many are turning to local efforts, recognizing that the path to influencing the broader election begins at home.
Recognizing the lack of coordinated canvassing technology and organization, two of Colorado’s conservative leaders, Heidi Ganahl and Geoff Sakala, have stepped in with a solution. Ganahl, the GOP’s 2022 gubernatorial candidate and founder of the Road to Red initiative and the Rocky Mountain Voice, and Sakala, founder of the Colorado Chase, have joined forces with Turning Point Action to launch the [Election Day Dash](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

|

**[Colorado Sens. Bennet, Hickenlooper introduce legislation to finish financing the long-delayed Arkansas Valley Conduit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Senators Michael Bennet and John Hickenlooper have introduced legislation to secure final funding for the Arkansas Valley Conduit, aiming to provide clean drinking water to over 50,000 families in southeastern Colorado.
* The conduit, a 130-mile pipeline from Pueblo Reservoir to Lamar, began construction in April 2023, with escalating costs now estimated at $1.3 billion due to inflation and labor costs.
* The proposed legislation would remove interest payments and extend the repayment period for the project from 50 to 100 years to ensure the project's affordability and completion.
* U.S. Representative Lauren Boebert has introduced a companion bill in the House, reflecting a bipartisan commitment to resolving long-standing water quality issues in the Arkansas Valley, emphasizing the importance of reliable and safe water access for regional development.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Aurora officials admit knowing about Venezuelan gang’s activities months ago](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Aurora officials have admitted to prior knowledge and ongoing arrests related to the activities of a Venezuelan gang significantly affecting local apartment complexes, well before recent heightened media attention.
* The gang's impact was confirmed to be localized to specific properties rather than widespread across Aurora, as detailed in a joint statement by Mayor Mike Coffman and Councilmember Danielle Jurinsky.
* Out of 10 individuals linked to the gang, Aurora Police Department (APD) has arrested eight, some of whom were involved in a July shooting at one of the affected properties.
* Despite previous awareness of the gang presence, the recent presidential debate spotlighted the issue nationally, prompting official confirmation of the details and the extent of the gang's activities in Aurora.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado ranchers ask U.S Fish and Wildlife to intervene, take control of wolf reintroduction program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado ranchers have requested federal intervention in wolf reintroduction efforts, dissatisfied with the state management by Colorado Parks and Wildlife due to significant livestock losses.
* Accusations suggest that decisions on wolf management are influenced by personal and political interests of Governor Jared Polis and First Gentleman Marlon Reis, rather than scientific or practical considerations.
* Ranchers criticize the state’s management as lacking transparency and effectiveness, particularly in handling depredation investigations and compensation, and contend that non-lethal conflict mitigation methods are inadequate.
* Ongoing wolf attacks continue despite the state's recent capture and containment of a problematic wolf pack.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[DA Linda Stanley to be disbarred over misconduct during Barry Morphew prosecution, state board rules](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CANON CITY DAILY RECORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* 11th Judicial District Attorney Linda Stanley will be disbarred for misconduct during the prosecution of Barry Morphew, related to his wife's disappearance and alleged murder.
* Stanley faced criticism for inappropriate media comments and inadequate supervision of the Morphew case, leading to discovery violations and a retaliatory probe against the judge.
* A disciplinary board emphasized that only disbarment could address her breach of public trust, marking her as potentially the first sitting district attorney in Colorado to be disbarred involuntarily.
* Despite the ruling, Stanley disputes the decision, considering an appeal; her disbarment disrupts her role as district attorney, prompting a potential replacement appointment by the governor.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Denver City Council postpones vote on $6 million immigration aid contract](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver City Council delayed a vote on a $6 million contract intended for Haven of Hope to distribute aid to immigrants, questioning the abandonment of a direct assistance model.
* Councilmembers expressed concerns about the effectiveness and legality of replacing direct financial assistance with physical distribution of goods, drawing parallels to the successful Denver Basic Income Project.
* The decision to postpone was unanimous, with councilmembers seeking greater clarity on legal issues and the most effective ways to support immigrants.

subject: You can be my human billboard!
body:
Your grassroots outreach will make all the difference. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3c884a1c1e16/why-would-you-want-an-extreme-politician-at-the-montana-supreme-court-14171468?e=5e62e9066d)
---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=e9203dee43&e=5e62e9066d)
|
# ,

Over the course of the past several months, I have waged a powerful grassroots campaign to educate and mobilize Montana voters to support my candidacy for Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court. That means thousands of miles on our family minivan. Dozens of hours standing with Lady Justice in front of Courthouses, raising awareness of the importance of the office of the Clerk. Time away from work and family. I do this because I know Montanans need and deserve a better Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court.
With the election right around the corner, my grassroots campaign to win this race is being fully deployed. [**Every dollar empowers me to spread my message to hundreds of thousands of Montana voters over the course of the forthcoming weeks**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=649109d634&e=5e62e9066d):
We need a Clerk who will effectively promote access to justice for all Montanans and keep politics away from the Montana Supreme Court!
---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=f525db7747&e=5e62e9066d)
| We do NOT need a Clerk who brings his political and activist agenda against Montana womens’ right to make our own private medical decisions to the office of the Clerk.
Montana voters are about to do their job, with absentee ballots and early voting starting very soon.
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=aeac2437f4&e=5e62e9066d)
| Please help me do my job to help educate them with a donation to my campaign.
[**Help me keep our justice system safe and impartial, and work to improve it in the interests of ALL Montanans. Your donation today of $20, $50, or even $100 will help ensure that we can get our mailers out to households across the state.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=a4372f677e&e=5e62e9066d)
Can I count you in?

Regards,
**Erin**

[**PS: Your personal donation of $100, $50, $25 - but no more than the $790 legal limit - will help fuel my successful grassroots campaign.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=e093cccf05&e=5e62e9066d)**** Please join our movement and encourage friends, family and professional colleagues to do the same.

body:

According to a _New York Times_ poll released several days ago, Kamala Harris trails Donald Trump nationally by one percent (47% to 48%). When you look at critical swing states, it's just as close. States like Nevada, Arizona, Pennsylvania... all tied. Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, and Georgia are all within the margin of error. Then consider that many of those states have similarly close Senate and House races. **Now realize that Democrats are being outspent in many of those states as well.** This is a close election and early voting starts soon in many of the states above. **Kamala Harris: Could She Be The New Threat to American Wealth, Middle Class, and Retirement Security?** Many Americans believed that Joe Biden’s presidency was a low point for the nation, with increasing taxes, rising inflation, and a faltering economy. However, the prospect of **Kamala Harris taking the reins has left many questioning if things could get even worse**. For the middle class, retirees, and anyone invested in 401Ks, Harris' policies may pose an even greater risk to financial stability.

**The Threat to Middle-Class Wealth and Retirement**

Kamala Harris' tax plan has been a point of concern for many. If implemented, it could significantly impact middle-class Americans, particularly those who are relying on their 401Ks and retirement savings. Harris has proposed higher taxes on wealth, which would hit not only the rich but also those who have diligently saved for retirement. The increase in taxes could mean that the[ **hard-earned savings of millions of Americans will be eroded** ,](http://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xtl=slceoeawohr60qlxp3vbs42zszk1jarnjt7gubwd29qoohlb9a9ttam9ys1hqym59r5sy8bk1gph35hec0civaj5o31vf6p1ih1sbov8hvnbdd4je0s3od4jq0c1k6ksjcr1gc8v9oxr8vj1odq19zob0ryvjablx7qrth4pr5h3m5uudmcrhp0nnk4xeslf0hrdusj7simlxwavt3tgax1ug74bwrq62fgl068zx9gzhe8rhork7m4l5h4arup2vd51lsltw5n3t3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sjpe43&__onlt=h) leaving them with less money to live on in their retirement years. Moreover, Harris' proposal to tax **unrealized gains raises significant concerns for investors and the broader economy.** By taxing gains that have not yet been realized, the policy could force individuals to pay taxes on investments that might decrease in value the following year, potentially resulting in financial strain if the market turns bearish. This could devastate retirees who rely on their 401Ks, as they might be forced to liquidate assets prematurely to cover these taxes,[**significantly reducing their retirement nest egg.**](http://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xtl=slceoeawohr60qlxp3vbs42zszk1jarnjvnmicqhhgv0h83e74du6mss0ammtlhb0jsg3ll71gfqduinfo3paodio5lagcilx4e9gsnc5cbh0oozp9ufadcwavt0b1r5g6z455xfd6jkyergcm0jik0s8ysjcz5tk1cqnjkpnbwaeyi6a954pt5otvn27pl5k2ezmizfkjhvzkwpx7ixuox1s9ciw0ati1akkemro1qijamllftz3nspbl59pgb0x9cm308c6ax7j8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sjpe43&__onlt=h)

Additionally, Harris's plan to increase the corporate **tax rate could prompt businesses to offset higher taxes by cutting costs,** often through layoffs, which could lead to higher unemployment. This combination of policies risks creating a challenging economic environment, where both individual and corporate financial stability are threatened, potentially stifling economic growth and increasing economic inequality. **The Weakening Dollar and Economic Instability**

Under Harris’s potential presidency, the dollar is likely to face significant pressure. The Fed is already torn between keeping interest rates high, which could lead to bank failures and increased unemployment, or cutting interest rates, which would fuel inflation and further weaken the dollar. The dollar's weakening isn't just a hypothetical scenario. **The rise of BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa)** has already started to challenge the dominance of the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency. [](http://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xtl=slceoeawohr60qlxp3vbs42zszk1jarnjfewggxvle6rqia6gr9xxpnnlfspkhhrgt1bwe9s1il55nkl9ifdna1zowcq2xazktunvlm4wdax7mr7nuitogcf557gr9cyordrxmsm8qazxl1jxh7t5rn8pwagdrn1c9q8uo4ogs4ap1eu916ui1gu9t7o9khkw3x293okt5cnlhlw5fknz6myuyfhtl44k4gkdgvm1h8674zey6c3vu1quv865wocegaqwaujnolg5o&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sjpe43&__onlt=h) **What a Kamala Harris Presidency Could Mean for You** If Kamala Harris wins, the middle class could face **higher taxes, diminished retirement accounts, and a weaker dollar** —all contributing to a more challenging financial landscape. With the government's ongoing deficit spending driving debt to unsustainable levels, the resulting economic instability could push more Americans toward financial ruin. The impact of a weakened dollar would ripple through the economy, leading to higher inflation, a drop in purchasing power, and a decline in the value of dollar-denominated assets. Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

| Dear Friend,
The people of Stuart's district deserve a representative who knows what real life is like -- and after 22 years in Washington DC, the simple fact is Stuart's opponent has grown out of touch with working Texas families. Congress has to go back to working FOR us, rather than ON us.
If you've had reason to be frustrated with our politics, you're with us. Together, we're going to fight together, stand as family, and on November 5th, Stuart will win.
So the real question is: [will you step up and volunteer?](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Z5gNePvhsEuze9ZFjWveOImUlf0eczxdkTknrxMtHah0TqLrP9yTGocmq5Jj7tMe2GA1vSbm_Cw7UNu_gjEa5oHctHCbcaJNmDPmDV2sh95FmUYMd5zYV8btTUYf0um2xWXHTYtgVr6JzUvej-HT0eutWNu3xQUUCO5odGCGFkJRQIbHyOtuWTrOmZCB6hajyiB7pAEgNzx6-5-iM2Foc3XrH9fpaOkPrSXkrr8IFP7n06IUn5iGEOdVRSrTwzxIkCv_vt_taaQ=&c=L8JoUdyuTLznmq-saGf8tt6gi27ol__SiGniEFcA3QIbc0RmlPafDg==&ch=HvIENuSyZMJFeo1vP6ryu46jIFFxWVCEfP6GW6BKVuuyc0Ox57cxhQ==)
Need to hear more before joining Team Whitlow? Keep reading below...
And if volunteering isn't the right move right now, [please consider a supporting donation of $100 or more, or whatever you can afford. Your donation today will help sponsor our volunteer squad as we get out the vote in TX-31.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Z5gNePvhsEuze9ZFjWveOImUlf0eczxdkTknrxMtHah0TqLrP9yTGocmq5Jj7tMeVRTscxv3sTwx9prTJIKfeC94B_SEYNgE5ZB6h1gcW4MSji-3KnuAydHRi_afRcFyZZ9qkbAUoAcCLkZITOSEXG3YfD-onmiXDIfo1v78MKIlP_9xAvOoFgPuRIcQXCedYvDhuzJRNwVuYQafvfgN6A==&c=L8JoUdyuTLznmq-saGf8tt6gi27ol__SiGniEFcA3QIbc0RmlPafDg==&ch=HvIENuSyZMJFeo1vP6ryu46jIFFxWVCEfP6GW6BKVuuyc0Ox57cxhQ==)
››› Chip in using this link: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/whitlow?refcode=sponsor_WhitlowVOLSquad](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Z5gNePvhsEuze9ZFjWveOImUlf0eczxdkTknrxMtHah0TqLrP9yTGocmq5Jj7tMeVRTscxv3sTwx9prTJIKfeC94B_SEYNgE5ZB6h1gcW4MSji-3KnuAydHRi_afRcFyZZ9qkbAUoAcCLkZITOSEXG3YfD-onmiXDIfo1v78MKIlP_9xAvOoFgPuRIcQXCedYvDhuzJRNwVuYQafvfgN6A==&c=L8JoUdyuTLznmq-saGf8tt6gi27ol__SiGniEFcA3QIbc0RmlPafDg==&ch=HvIENuSyZMJFeo1vP6ryu46jIFFxWVCEfP6GW6BKVuuyc0Ox57cxhQ==)
Team Whitlow volunteers have already accomplished some amazing things -- from packed organizing meetings in Round Rock, to our road sign program's milestones and more -- it's clear we have momentum on our side. To turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, now we need all hands on deck.
Everything is on the line for hardworking Texas families this election, but WE have the power to shape the outcome of Stuart's election and secure a serious victory for Democrats seeking to regain control of the U.S. House. “Farmers and ranchers are affected by climate change,” she said. “The cost of feed is higher than it needs to be. If someone is injured, there’s no hospital close by. And they can’t do telemedicine if they don’t have broadband. I want to fix all that and more.”
“What about the kids?” I said.
“Most kids leave after high school because they can’t earn enough locally,” Trisha said. “Kids shouldn’t have to choose whether to stay with family or leave for opportunity. I’m running to give them a ladder up so they can do both.”
Between Trisha Calvarese and Lauren Boebert, which one do you think cares more about her American neighbors wherever they live?

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240912-1-160&refcode2=3066.734936.0yZQ70&t=1&akid=3066%2E734936%2E0yZQ70)

As a Marine Corps veteran, I never imagined having to use my training to protect myself and my colleagues on the House floor.
I never imagined teaching my House colleagues how to put on a gas mask and regulate their breathing.
I never imagined I’d be helping frightened colleagues move to safety as insurrectionists started streaming into the Capitol.
I never imagined I’d stay behind after the Capitol security came in to do one more sweep for colleagues who might have frozen and gone to cocoon somewhere hard to find.
I never imagined I would ever have to teach my staff how to knock on the door of our office a certain way to signal it was them and not some attacker — something we did in the Marine Corps when surrounded by insurgents and you didn’t know who was good and who was bad.
And I never imagined I’d have to text members of the House and urge them not to get on buses ready to evacuate us from the Capitol because if we left we’d lose the building to the coup.
Maybe it is the Marine in me, but I will always fight for our democracy. I'd have done it in the Capitol that day — and I will fight as hard as I can to win this race and keep Kari Lake out of the Senate.
Trump’s coming to Tucson, Arizona later today. It’s his first big speech since the debate, and he’s coming because he knows how important this state is. If Trump and the GOP win Arizona they win the presidency and they take control of the Senate. We can't let that happen, and I can't do it without you.

| | Friend, I’ve made my stance clear in the House—enough is enough. The easiest way to fix a hole is to stop digging, and yet, Washington is at it again. They want another [stopgap funding bill](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=6e5ab6e33dc14e889084c90911b81cec&_e=3VcgmCOiyqJFiRUCHzH5KdWDVz9NoQTmW6iNuXJ0n7SeisaJxl0GBbp3DSTYSqExfnSaDmgTKa8qhs2WXMYkOhWSWbgSFakN1xCX1o_qCvKCc901pe3xjsUsCd-l8saDkx5F7jb1TsaEeYKUw7mqa1o9Qkq8sNzJOBmTrzavqtTEHtA1R5pcK_Ur9NggGYQK67RUAkyXmGsWRrjoX_h5610Pu9JbJPB2LRQmRUw3PaoamtDujgW9TPNYeS-KybP7ZiMBnjmiV-DQNL0esAF4sQVqMYRYwsU_KG8JJEpirTNNlcmc9HXjOI6tQ8gV3zBr), another temporary Band-Aid to keep the government running on borrowed time and borrowed money. Friend, it’s the same old game: spend, spend, and kick the can down the road. This isn’t about keeping the government open—it’s about stopping runaway spending that’s already left us with crippling inflation, soaring debt, and a weaker economy. And what does Washington do? They push for more of the same junk. It’s sick. I won’t back down. They can call me a [troublemaker](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=6e5ab6e33dc14e889084c90911b81cec&_e=3VcgmCOiyqJFiRUCHzH5KStWEc3ryhHYMz9dRoCVJrDnDoqKIpj5j3XlKa8ca4XUB9b0m7pGW0Lj8w9EtjqKHePevDzSslCUR2wQGH9KaiitwoxeaHym3sKXYZh5AQTceLo0yOQ-9TsBZoyA1tvjfqbgrmFGvsXChUOoBKjfMGg2lhTkp1WXd_C1lPZC0ll6TPxPyGPSFh7dz8hT-1abhYbWS0Fy7_iXUGu_v6Y55zQ7N9pf2ADBW3954eyZ9bqNmcvhQbynCEPRfGh4saQ4_7GwFTlWCXu83HN3uk6F_SdAsDxcsK7p7NU3kH0Xci9ApB0uQEWhph2PPIxY6u6vTOXNdgg8-8HTpVuNwQxSl-I%3D) all they want, but the real troublemakers are the ones who keep digging us deeper into this financial mess. I’m not here to play politics or be a puppet for special interests—I’m here to fight for the American people, for fiscal responsibility, and for the future of our country. We deserve better than this broken system that spends recklessly and makes us all pay the price. Families across the country are feeling the squeeze of higher costs, mounting debt, and a future being stolen by Washington’s incompetence. It’s infuriating, and I’m not afraid to stand up and say, “ENOUGH!” I refuse to let the people who caused this crisis keep dragging us down. I’ll keep fighting this madness with everything I’ve got, because our country’s future is worth it.

clean_body: ENOUGH | | | | | | | | Friend, I’ve made my stance clear in the House—enough is enough. The easiest way to fix a hole is to stop digging, and yet, Washington is at it again. They want another , another temporary Band-Aid to keep the government running on borrowed time and borrowed money. Friend, it’s the same old game: spend, spend, and kick the can down the road. This isn’t about keeping the government open—it’s about stopping runaway spending that’s already left us with crippling inflation, soaring debt, and a weaker economy. And what does Washington do? They push for more of the same junk. It’s sick. I won’t back down. They can call me a all they want, but the real troublemakers are the ones who keep digging us deeper into this financial mess. We deserve better than this broken system that spends recklessly and makes us all pay the price. It’s infuriating, and I’m not afraid to stand up and say, “ENOUGH!” I refuse to let the people who caused this crisis keep dragging us down. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091224_1&amount=25]
Folks,
Opponents of voting rights in the U.S. House are attempting to pass the " Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act ," a last-minute bill requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. Never mind that it is already against federal law for non-citizens to vote.
This proposal is nothing more than a blatant voter suppression tactic aimed at disenfranchising vulnerable communities , particularly minorities and low-income voters, who may struggle to produce the necessary documentation. Vote suppressors are using the ongoing government shutdown negotiations as leverage to push this harmful legislation through Congress.
Voting rights experts have sounded the alarm on this bill, warning that it could lead to widespread disenfranchisement. The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice highlighted that proof-of-citizenship requirements disproportionately affect naturalized citizens , who may be wrongly removed from voter rolls due to outdated or incorrect data. This bill would make it significantly harder for these legal citizens to participate in our democracy, all under the guise of "election integrity."
Sign our petition now: Demand that Congress act now to stop this dangerous legislation! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

We cannot allow this attack on voting rights to go unchallenged .
Vice President Kamala Harris has made it clear that protecting the right to vote is a top priority for this administration. Meanwhile, opponents of voting rights are doing everything they can to undermine our electoral system by making it harder for people to vote.
By signing this petition, you're telling Congress to reject the SAVE Act and protect the voting rights of every American. We need to stand up against these voter suppression tactics and ensure that our democracy remains inclusive and fair.
Don't let opponents of voting rights succeed in their efforts to silence millions of voters. name: Michelle at United We Dream Action
subject: Our lives are at stake.
body:
UWDA has officially endorsed the Harris-Walz ticket | | | Listen, Peter: This is one of the most important elections of our lifetime. Our lives are at stake, and this race is going to be _incredibly_ close. Millions of people will vote for Donald Trump, Republicans, and their white supremacist playbook that calls for mass deportations and the destruction of our immigration system. So we need more people to vote against them. **That’s why UWDA made a strategic and difficult decision to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz this week because we know one thing is certain: we must do everything we can to defeat Trump.** This isn’t about relying on one politician to save us — it’s about voting for the conditions that allow us to live and fight another day, and continue applying pressure on our elected officials to center progressive policies and our Youth Agenda in their work. Let’s BFFR: Politicians won’t save us. **We will save us.** But in order to do that, we need, _at a minimum_ , an administration that isn’t devising a playbook to deport our communities, revoke our freedoms, and make it nearly impossible for us to continue organizing.
**We can’t organize our vision of the future under a Trump presidency. That’s why we NEED to elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Not for them, but for us.** **[We’re counting on you to step up and support our work of mobilizing young voters between now and Election Day. We have the power to sway this election, Peter, but we need your help. I'm reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt request. This month, Live Action is partnering with pro-life pregnancy resource centers nationwide to provide onesies for mothers and babies in need. Will you join us for our first-ever onesie drive?

This month only, a gift of $60 will provide three custom "Wonderfully Made" onesies to three moms and their babies at risk of abortion. These onesies are more than just clothing--they are symbols of hope and reminders that every child is a precious gift, beautifully and wonderfully made. [ ](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjU2LThkYThiNDhjOTdhNTQ5ZjE5ODg2MjczNjJkODljNmQ0IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1MTE81NDgzNCJ9/NUOPGHkXLqaBOxx6gnqTLA)
Onesies are a basic necessity for every baby. More than that, they symbolize the love and care each new life needs to thrive--a tangible representation of personal connection and love for both mother and baby. For mothers facing unplanned pregnancies or struggling with financial difficulties, having the basics provided can make all the difference in helping them feel supported.

Every baby is a gift that deserves to be cherished and provided for, and every mother deserves to know her baby is treasured not just by her but also by her community.

Abortion providers like Planned Parenthood rely on women feeling isolated by their unplanned pregnancies. Together, we can show these courageous women they are supported and loved by a community that values every life.

To make this possible, you can donate $60 to send custom onesies to three moms and babies in need. Click here to donate: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-onesie-today/](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjU2LThkYThiNDhjOTdhNTQ5ZjE5ODg2MjczNjJkODljNmQ0IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1MTE81NDgzNCJ9/2YK9H28eBJAHfq8zd1iXcQ)**

For Life,

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 12, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Kevin Faulconer Unveils New Ad Targeting Terra Lawson-Remer for Failing to Show Up for Work While San Diego’s Problems Get Worse**
**San Diego, CA** — Today, the Faulconer for Supervisor campaign unveiled a powerful new ad exposing incumbent Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer for her repeated failure to show up for work. The ad reveals that Lawson-Remer has missed nearly half of all County Supervisor meetings, skipped hundreds of critical votes, and failed to attend the county wide homeless task force of which she is vice chair—all while collecting a taxpayer-funded paycheck of $287,000 per year.
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=3cc31737e5&e=784f78234b)
[CLICK HERE TO WATCH: “No Show Lawson-Remer”](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=a1df64612c&e=784f78234b)
| _**"Terra Lawson-Remer isn’t doing her job. If any regular person missed nearly half of their workdays or ignored their duties, they’d be fired.without pay. Yet, she continues to collect her $287,000 paycheck as if she’s earned it,” said Kevin Faulconer. “Her absence on important votes and committees shows she’s more interested in keeping her title than serving the people of San Diego. We can't afford to let Terra Lawson-Remer coast while homelessness is out of control and more people are dying on our streets than ever before."**_
The ad exposes Lawson-Remer’s troubling pattern of being a no-show for essential county business, even at a time when San Diego County faces significant challenges—particularly with homelessness. Under Faulconer’s leadership as mayor, homelessness declined, and every year Lawson-Remer has been in office, homelessness has skyrocketed. Homeless deaths have also surged to historic levels, reaching a 10-year high. It’s clear from her record that Lawson-Remer is more focused on personal priorities than the well-being of San Diego County.
View the ad [here](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=f3ac9fd130&e=784f78234b).
**Transcript:**
_“How can San Diego make progress on big problems like homelessness when our County Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer doesn’t show up for work?”_
_“Lawson-Remer has missed nearly half of county supervisor meetings and skipped hundreds of votes.”_
_“Worse, she’s missed every meeting of the homeless task force she’s supposed to lead.”_
_“But Terra Lawson-Remer never misses a paycheck”_
_“If you didn’t show up for work you’d be fired without pay!”_
_“It’s time we fire no-show Terra as our County Supervisor.”_
###

Kevin has served our nation as a Marine and a mayor in California. Now, he’s running for one of the most competitive congressional seats in the country, right in Kamala’s backyard. He knows how to win as a Republican in California. And that scares the Left. I know firsthand the nasty names that Democrats call black and minority Republicans. I’ve been called EVERY NAME in the book. They will do the same to Kevin Lincoln. That’s why we need to do whatever we can to help him win this November. Fellow American, right now we have a slim majority in the House of Representatives. If we have any chance of passing the conservative agenda, I need new partners like Kevin Lincoln in Washington. Please, don’t give up on this opportunity to send a message to Kamala Harris and the radical Left. Thanks, Byron Donalds | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. Like , Follow , and Subscribe! clean_body: After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make. Hello, After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make. When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits. Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children. After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last. I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith. Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat. # We Vote, We Win
In 2022, a stunning 153,000 registered Republicans in Connecticut didn’t cast their votes. Think about that. With all the issues we care about—taxes, personal freedom, school choice, and holding government accountable in Hartford—incredibly, so many stayed home.
We can’t afford to let this happen again. It’s time we learn from this and build a solid plan to get Republicans off the couch and into the voting booth. The stakes are too high to sit this one out.
In the coming weeks, I will provide a series of tools RTCs (Republican Town Committees) can use to enhance local GOTV (Get Out the Vote) efforts. We’ll break down different voter segments and create targeted approaches for each group. Whether it’s getting early votes banked from high-propensity voters, encouraging low-propensity voters to make their voice count, or securing the legacy of our elderly supporters by voting early, each segment needs a tailored plan.
Let’s get ready. We vote, we win. Stay tuned for more tools to help us energize Republican voters and drive them to the polls!
---
[](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=bcec5d71ac&e=8763c56857)
|
# Republicans Love In-Person Voting

We understand the sentiment surrounding voting by mail and the preference for showing up on Election Day—it’s part of the tradition for many Republicans. But we have to face the reality: times have changed, and we need to embrace every tool available to us. If we don’t, the Democrats will, and we’ll be left behind.
Your vote matters. While Election Day voting remains essential, we can’t afford to overlook absentee voting or early voting. These options are attractive to a lot of people and allow us to secure votes well ahead of the rush.
The truth is, the more we focus on voting early, the better our chances of turning out Republican voters and ensuring our voices are heard.
It’s time to focus all our energy on encouraging people to vote early and vote Republican. By doing so, we will increase turnout and give ourselves the strategic advantage we need to win.
Let’s embrace the future and use every opportunity to strengthen our movement!
**This is the first of several GOTV Toolbox emails.**
**Stay tuned, and stay hungry. We got this!**
**ACTION:** Send members of your RTC to www.dominicforct.us to sign up for my GOTV Toolbox emails

clean_body: A series of GOTV Resources and Plan =s | | | | | | | | We Vote, We Win In 2022, a stunning 153,000 registered Republicans in Connecticut didn’t cast their votes. Think about that. With all the issues we care about—taxes, personal freedom, school choice, and holding government accountable in Hartford—incredibly, so many stayed home. We can’t afford to let this happen again. It’s time we learn from this and build a solid plan to get Republicans off the couch and into the voting booth. The stakes are too high to sit this one out. In the coming weeks, I will provide a series of tools RTCs (Republican Town Committees) can use to enhance local GOTV (Get Out the Vote) efforts. We’ll break down different voter segments and create targeted approaches for each group. Whether it’s getting early votes banked from high-propensity voters, encouraging low-propensity voters to make their voice count, or securing the legacy of our elderly supporters by voting early, each segment needs a tailored plan. Let’s get ready. We vote, we win. Stay tuned for more tools to help us energize Republican voters and drive them to the polls! | Republicans Love In-Person Voting We understand the sentiment surrounding voting by mail and the preference for showing up on Election Day—it’s part of the tradition for many Republicans. But we have to face the reality: times have changed, and we need to embrace every tool available to us. If we don’t, the Democrats will, and we’ll be left behind. Your vote matters. While Election Day voting remains essential, we can’t afford to overlook absentee voting or early voting. These options are attractive to a lot of people and allow us to secure votes well ahead of the rush. The truth is, the more we focus on voting early, the better our chances of turning out Republican voters and ensuring our voices are heard. It’s time to focus all our energy on encouraging people to vote early and vote Republican. By doing so, we will increase turnout and give ourselves the strategic advantage we need to win. Let’s embrace the future and use every opportunity to strengthen our movement! This is the first of several GOTV Toolbox emails. Stay tuned, and stay hungry. We got this! body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1911%2E135344%2E6b7Nqd)

Friend --
Our campaign just released a new TV ad about what’s at stake in this election and women's freedom to make decisions about their own bodies.
The ad is about Sarah, from West Michigan, the baby that she and her husband desperately wanted, and the life-saving care that Sarah received when she lost the pregnancy. I’m grateful to Sarah and her family for sharing their heart-wrenching story with me, and with all of you. It’s incredibly brave. You can watch the ad here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/220?c0=ebs-em-abortionad-sep24.7_5ssS&refcode=em240912-2-900&t=2&akid=1911%2E135344%2E6b7Nqd)
Sarah’s story is one that many Michiganders know all too well.
The last thing that families faced with the heartbreak of losing a pregnancy need is politicians getting involved with their healthcare.
And my opponent has a 20-year voting record on this topic that shows he will not stand with women like Sarah. All you need to do is stick to the cold hard facts: starting in 1994, he told the Lansing State Journal that he supports “all restrictions on abortion.” In 2000, he supported a nationwide abortion ban. Between 2005 and 2013, he co-sponsored bills that would have restricted IVF and some forms of birth control. In 2023, he made clear that he would have voted against a woman’s right to choose in Michigan if he had not been voting in Florida at the time. All told, he voted for 8 abortion bans and 48 additional measures that would limit reproductive freedom in his 20 years in office.
At the end of the day, this election is about who you trust to protect your rights, and the rights of your children. It’s about the deeply personal decisions that Michigan families make every day about when and how to start a family and the pain of pregnancy loss. It’s about healthcare decisions made in consultation with a doctor, and whether politicians should be able to intervene in those private — and often tragic — moments.
I will fight for Michigan women to make those decisions in consultation with their loved ones and their healthcare providers, not politicians. And my record is crystal clear on this topic. No need to hide. No need to dodge.
[**Will you chip in $3 to help us share this message with Michiganders?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/220?c0=ebs-em-abortionad-sep24.7_5ssS&refcode=em240912-2-900&t=3&akid=1911%2E135344%2E6b7Nqd)

Ohio farmers grow some of the best produce in the country, so it's always a treat to visit them, hear how the crop's doing, and pick up some fresh produce. This year we're trying Zestar!® apples!

**I've spent my career fighting for the Dignity of Work and the good folks of Ohio – including the 1 in 7 Ohioans who depend on agriculture for their livelihoods – because I believe that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.**

body:
This is our chance
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2855105/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

**It's time to hold fossil fuel companies accountable.**

If you've lived through this summer of record heat waves, droughts, and floods, then you know that the impacts of climate change are getting worse.

So here's a simple idea: **The corporations most responsible for climate change should pay to address those climate impacts.**

Thankfully, that's just what a new groundbreaking bill in Congress aims to do. [**Will you add your name in support of this commonsense legislation today?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2855106/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2855107/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Just today, Senator Chris Van Hollen and Congressman Jerry Nadler introduced the Polluters Pay Climate Fund Act, which would require top-polluting fossil fuel companies to pay $1 trillion _(with a "t")_ to a fund dedicated to addressing the impacts of climate change while building a better future.

**This bill would #MakePollutersPay for things like:**
* Rebuilding and upgrading infrastructure
* Cleaning up pollution in frontline communities
* Providing climate-related disaster assistance
* Prioritizing at least 40% of investments for environmental justice communities

|
---
| For over 60 years, fossil fuel companies have known that their business practices are harming our climate and putting all of us in danger, but they lobbied to protect their profits and stall climate action.

**It's past time for Big Polluters to pay their fair share.**

It's time for them to stop leaving it to local governments to pay for addressing the problems that they created.

There's no time to waste. [**You can help now by telling Congress to support the Polluters Pay Climate Fund.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2855108/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[MAKE POLLUTERS PAY](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2855109/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thanks for all you do, |
---

name: Diane Sare
subject: This Friday Symposium -- Nuclear Energy To The Rescue
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sare for Senate
body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nuclear_energy_now_on_the_tabl&n=1)
---
Friend -- In a surprise turn, nuclear energy became a major focus of New York's Future of Energy Summit, which took place on September 5th of this year in Syracuse, NY. Why was Governor Kathy Hochul -- the champion of sending billions of dollars of subsidies to wind and solar corporate and financial entities -- forced to include nuclear energy in her future plans? Perhaps the exploding energy bills of constituents, the reports from NYSERDA, the NYIOS and the State Comptroller documenting failed objectives and the perilous state of the grid, and the need to get energy to Micron have all had an effect. But it is more than that. As a candidate in 2022, I protested the insane shutdown of the safe and productive Indian Point nuclear power plant in 2021, which provided 25% of the energy for New York City and Westchester County. Indian Point was developed as a result of President Dwight Eisenhower's "Atoms for Peace" initiative, and involved the highest levels of skilled labor from start to finish. We need the energy flux density of nuclear processes to move forward! | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: AIPAC is extremist, not moderate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, some will
have you believe that AIPAC, the anti-Palestinian lobby group funded by
Republican megadonors and corporate special interests, is moderate.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240912.-84PTj&refcode=em20240912-35986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35986%2E1203867%2ESdW1td ]Tweet from Beth Miller: It is obscene to call a group that spend $100m
to scare electeds into supporting military funding for a foreign
government that is slaughtering and starving Palestinians “moderate.”
AIPAC’s policies are extremist and their tactics are build around fear.
[screenshot of headline: AIPAC emerges as moderate force in political
primaries]

Make no mistake: AIPAC threatens the foundation of our democracy by buying
elections and using its war chest to scare elected officials into giving
unconditional support to Israel’s genocidal, right-wing government.

AIPAC may have won in New York and St Louis this summer by spending over
$25 million in the most expensive congressional primaries in history, but
that doesn’t mean they’re winning. With your support, we’re giving them a
run for their money, forcing them to spend more than ever before to win
races and push for policies that the majority of voters reject.

By not backing down from AIPAC, our progressive bloc in Congress is not
only fighting for human rights for all people but fighting back against
fascism and the corporate takeover of our democracy. Our mandate is clear:
we must get big money out of politics. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240912.-84PTj&refcode=em20240912-35986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35986%2E1203867%2ESdW1td ]If you agree, support Justice
Democrats’ work to do just that with a grassroots donation of
$5 today →

When our Party discusses fascism, we often focus on Donald Trump — and
while he is a major threat to our democracy, solely focusing on Trump
ignores the systemic issues we face, like our broken campaign finance
system that enables AIPAC to wield such power and influence.

This fight is bigger than AIPAC: the lobby group has created a blueprint
for right-wing Super PACs to try buying elections and put forth a playbook
that is now being replicated by other corporate and wealthy interests,
like the cryptocurrency and Big Tech industries. It’s beyond time for the
Democratic Party to get serious about campaign finance reform and take big
money out of politics once and for all.

Primary battles like Jamaal Bowman’s and Cori Bush’s are an assault on our
democracy, and no Super PAC—no matter the issue or ideology—should be
allowed to spend this much money in our elections. Now is the time we put
people back at the center of our democracy, and democracy back at the
center of our Party.

Every single one of our progressive priorities faces the same obstacle: a
broken campaign finance system that allows corporations and special
interest groups to control our Democratic agenda with their wallets. If we
want an end to the genocide in Palestine, Medicare for All, and a Green
New Deal, then we have to end a system that prioritizes the needs of
corporate defense contractors, Big Pharma and health insurance companies,
and Big Oil and the fossil fuel industry over the priorities of everyday
people.

The Joe Manchin’s and Kyrsten Sinema’s of the world don’t obstruct labor
law legislation or climate change policies for themselves, but on behalf
of their biggest corporate benefactors who have bought that influence in
Congress.

Many of the same donors who are spending against progressives like Cori
and Jamaal are threatening Kamala Harris to back their corporate policies,
or else.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240912.-84PTj&refcode=em20240912-35986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=35986%2E1203867%2ESdW1td ]The entire Democratic Party must fight back against these interests if
we want to have a reflective, social democracy that centers people, not
corporate interests. If you’re with us, fuel the fight ahead by pitching
in whatever you can afford now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240912.-84PTj&refcode=em20240912-35986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35986%2E1203867%2ESdW1td ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Peter,
Donald Trump is pretty upset about losing Tuesday’s debate. After _ABC News_ moderators fact-checked Trump in real-time (including calling him out for suggesting that doctors were murdering infants after birth), Trump and his allies whined and said they were cheating.
**Trump even threatened _ABC News_ with an investigation if he should win the Presidency in November. **
**[We’ll explain more in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s efforts to call out right-wing lies and propaganda, can you pitch in $25 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92684772/497954509/-593472309?refcode=20240912-EM-postdebate2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjAzYmNlYjYtMmU3MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JQAs-tRhJd9NItUU_4tNnDwmo6eMULpSR4KJlet0abE=)**
In June, _CNN_ ’s debate between Trump and Biden notably did not include live fact-checking. The result was that Trump told hundreds of lies in a 90-minute span.
Most of the post-debate media coverage focused on Joe Biden, meaning that Trump’s lies went unchecked to tens of millions of voters.
**_ABC News_ correctly fixed the error on Tuesday. On everything from abortion to bogus election fraud claims, they weren’t afraid to jump in and call out Trump for lying.**
After it was clear that Harris won the debate handily, Trump and his allies used the fact-checking as an excuse to say she and _ABC_ “cheated.” Here’s what we mean:
* Donald Trump said the debate was a three-against-one and, in echoes of his 2020 election lies, called it “a rigged deal.”
* Conservative pundit Megyn Kelly called the moderators “failures,” calling the debate “one of the most biased, unfair debates I have ever seen.”
* Fox News contributor and former George W. Bush staffer Ari Fleischer cut to the chase: "_ABC_ is making a huge mistake trying to fact check this live. They're only proving how biased they are.”

Here’s the thing, Peter: these claims of cheating aren’t just about trying to spin a bad debate performance. **They are about laying the foundation to claim that, if Harris wins the 2024 election, she did it illegitimately. That Democrats and the so-called left-leaning media colluded to steal the election. **
That sounds an awful lot like 2020, Peter. On January 6th, we saw what happens when these lies aren’t corrected.
With polls tight, Trump and the right-wing media are already preparing their audiences to distrust election results by calling the election rigged and accusing Democrats and the media of cheating.

**Reuters: California passes requirements on carmakers and domestic violence**

By [Dan Levine](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=14e57bcf05&e=7017cc100e) and [Kristina Cooke](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=32cc3e9c43&e=7017cc100e)
Sept 10 (Reuters) - Lawmakers in the most populous U.S. state approved a proposal that requires automakers selling internet-connected cars to do more to protect domestic abuse survivors, in what appears to be the first measure in the nation addressing the issue to pass a legislature.

As automakers add ever more sophisticated technology to their cars, instances of stalking and harassment using features such as location tracking and remote controls have begun to emerge.

The bill, which passed the California state legislature late last month with overwhelming support, now awaits a decision from Governor Gavin Newsom on whether he will sign it into law. **One of the bill's authors, state Senator Dave Min, said Newsom's staff had been involved in negotiations over its terms, as were different car manufacturers, including Tesla [(TSLA.O)](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=13636976f0&e=7017cc100e).**

Tara Gallegos, deputy director of communications for Newsom, said in an email on Monday that the measure will be "evaluated on its merits." Tesla has not filed any public letters in support of or opposition to the bill, and the company did not respond to a request for comment.

The bill, which passed the California state legislature late last month with overwhelming support, now awaits a decision from Governor Gavin Newsom on whether he will sign it into law. One of the bill's authors, state Senator Dave Min, said Newsom's staff had been involved in negotiations over its terms, as were different car manufacturers, including Tesla . Tara Gallegos, deputy director of communications for Newsom, said in an email on Monday that the measure will be "evaluated on its merits." Tesla has not filed any public letters in support of or opposition to the bill, and the company did not respond to a request for comment. | This email was sent to mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com Dave Min For Senate PO Box 5959 Irvine, CA 92616-5959 * USA

* **$2.59 million** for Boeing to support its efforts to improve the measurement of fuel quality in an airplane fuel tank.

subject: I lived next to a burn pit in Iraq

body:
This is a story of how Republicans like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me
#
Peter — two years ago, Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71274?refcode=em20240912-7638&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7638%2E614464%2ETq4hqa)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make your first donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71274?refcode=em20240912-7638&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7638%2E614464%2ETq4hqa) But first, I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like him failed veterans like me.**
**[ADD DONATION NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71274?refcode=em20240912-7638&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7638%2E614464%2ETq4hqa)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71274?refcode=em20240912-7638&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7638%2E614464%2ETq4hqa)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger? I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can stay on track with our goals this month, get this message in front of Missouri voters, and defeat Josh Hawley this November.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71274?refcode=em20240912-7638&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7638%2E614464%2ETq4hqa)

body:

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92688769/497968095/-651014446?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-scr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzZDhkYTJiLTM2NzEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DqxudMxBFlnmgpI0uqeW9n8HI2j43boMvRFLu6zA27E=&emci=3b722c4a-6470-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d3d8da2b-3671-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551)

| | Dear Peter,
---
We wanted you to be one of the first people to hear our big news.

We are proud to share an opportunity to acquire the 1,624-acre [**Sonoma Coast Redwoods**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92688771/497968097/-651014446?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-scr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzZDhkYTJiLTM2NzEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DqxudMxBFlnmgpI0uqeW9n8HI2j43boMvRFLu6zA27E=&emci=3b722c4a-6470-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d3d8da2b-3671-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551)—a stunning stretch of coastal California, where raptors soar high above redwood forests, windswept prairie, and a shimmering expanse of the Pacific Ocean. Protecting this remarkable Sonoma County property, just south of Fort Ross State Historic Park, would expand outdoor access and create the potential to extend the California Coastal Trail. It would connect habitat for endangered animals and protect a resilient redwood forest on its way to becoming the old growth we know and love.

But first we must prevent this breathtaking landscape from being developed into private estates.

Along this serene expanse of coastline, with its redwoods and sweeping ocean views, there’s a constant risk of development,” said **Sam Hodder** , president and CEO of Save the Redwoods League. “It’s essential that we act now to ensure the rugged beauty, ecological and cultural resources, fire resilience, and carbon capacity of Sonoma Coast Redwoods are secured for generations.”
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92688772/497968098/-651014446?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-scr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzZDhkYTJiLTM2NzEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DqxudMxBFlnmgpI0uqeW9n8HI2j43boMvRFLu6zA27E=&emci=3b722c4a-6470-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d3d8da2b-3671-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551)
[**This project is big and we’re looking to raise the remaining $9 million for acquisition and project costs by December 31.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92688773/497968099/-651014446?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-scr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzZDhkYTJiLTM2NzEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DqxudMxBFlnmgpI0uqeW9n8HI2j43boMvRFLu6zA27E=&emci=3b722c4a-6470-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d3d8da2b-3671-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551)

It’s rare that a Sonoma coastal property of this significance becomes available. Located in the ancestral territory of the Kashia people, the parcel includes 836 acres of redwoods, from new saplings springing back after wildfire to old-growth giants up to 1,000 years old. This variety indicates a healthy recovering forest—the kind where young trees can grow quickly and pack away large amounts of carbon when the planet needs it most. By safeguarding this forest now, we can lock in crucial climate benefits for the long term.

Our plan is to transfer this land to public ownership, in line with our goal of increasing the number of stunning redwood destinations that are accessible to all. We are currently engaging with prospective tribal, parks, and funding partners to determine a permanent steward and ensure that the property’s extraordinary conservation, cultural, and recreational resources are forever preserved.

Right now, we have a collective opportunity to safeguard this spectacular place. We can connect wildlife habitat, build fire resilience, and protect a stunning redwood landscape for future visitors and the 2 million people who live nearby. This is our chance to be good ancestors and ensure that the beauty and benefits of Sonoma Coast Redwoods stretch far into the future.

Learn more about this important project, and how you can help.

clean_body: This iconic California landscape needs our help | | | | Dear Peter, We wanted you to be one of the first people to hear our big news. We are proud to share an opportunity to acquire the 1,624-acre —a stunning stretch of coastal California, where raptors soar high above redwood forests, windswept prairie, and a shimmering expanse of the Pacific Ocean. Protecting this remarkable Sonoma County property, just south of Fort Ross State Historic Park, would expand outdoor access and create the potential to extend the California Coastal Trail. It would connect habitat for endangered animals and protect a resilient redwood forest on its way to becoming the old growth we know and love. But first we must prevent this breathtaking landscape from being developed into private estates. Along this serene expanse of coastline, with its redwoods and sweeping ocean views, there’s a constant risk of development,” said Sam Hodder , president and CEO of Save the Redwoods League. “It’s essential that we act now to ensure the rugged beauty, ecological and cultural resources, fire resilience, and carbon capacity of Sonoma Coast Redwoods are secured for generations.” It’s rare that a Sonoma coastal property of this significance becomes available. Located in the ancestral territory of the Kashia people, the parcel includes 836 acres of redwoods, from new saplings springing back after wildfire to old-growth giants up to 1,000 years old. This variety indicates a healthy recovering forest—the kind where young trees can grow quickly and pack away large amounts of carbon when the planet needs it most. By safeguarding this forest now, we can lock in crucial climate benefits for the long term. Our plan is to transfer this land to public ownership, in line with our goal of increasing the number of stunning redwood destinations that are accessible to all. We are currently engaging with prospective tribal, parks, and funding partners to determine a permanent steward and ensure that the property’s extraordinary conservation, cultural, and recreational resources are forever preserved. Right now, we have a collective opportunity to safeguard this spectacular place. We can connect wildlife habitat, build fire resilience, and protect a stunning redwood landscape for future visitors and the 2 million people who live nearby. This is our chance to be good ancestors and ensure that the beauty and benefits of Sonoma Coast Redwoods stretch far into the future. September 12, 2024
America has a ruling class: The ultrawealthy along with a bureaucratic, judicial and political class that is overwhelmingly educated by Ivy League institutions, especially Harvard and Yale.
Their viewpoints on globalism, immigration and climate change urgency are not shared by the majority of the population. Furthermore, they are highly incompetent and cater to the White Upper Middle Class (WUMC) while paying off the poor for their votes. Meanwhile, the middle class is consigned to living paycheck to paycheck to finance necessities with credit cards charging 27% interest.
The ruling class of all societies has one major interest - cheap labor. For most of human history, slaves toiled in food production, mining, building housing and edifices to power (pyramids, castles etc.) and menial household chores. To refuse resulted in death.
Religious institutions successfully ended slavery in some areas only to see it replaced by feudalism. The rise of unbridled capitalism upended feudalism but workers still were forced to work at subsistence wages until unions formed.
But the ruling class still needed cheap labor - thus globalism. Good paying jobs were shipped to low-wage countries such as Mexico, India and China. Workers lost ground while corporations made huge profits enriching the stock-owning WUMC.
But there are those pesky elections. To stay in power, the ruling class had to dole out benefits to the poor, enabling them to refuse to do menial labor such as childcare, house cleaning and maintenance.
Thus, the ruling class came up with a new labor force - illegal immigrants.
Both political parties agreed with this agenda while tinkering with issues such as abortion, differences in tax policy, capital punishment etc. depending upon public opinion polls in specific districts and states.
Then one man emerged to challenge the ruling class. Donald Trump. Treated by the media as a laughingstock, the billionaire gadfly shocked the ruling class by upsetting their sock puppet Hillary Clinton.
Their response was swift and vicious. Charges of "Russian interference" stymied his presidency but he still managed to bless the country with four years of peace and prosperity.
COVID was used as an excuse to legalize billionaire-financed ballot harvesting and even though Trump was comfortably ahead on election night in 2020, huge ballot dumps put Biden over the top, even though he hardly bothered to campaign.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8d445b20-6922-4859-8c41-25748017f2cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Graph of Trump vote (in red) and Biden vote (in blue) in swing states after ballot dumping in 2020 and probably graph of Trump Harris returns in 2024
If Trump had any sense, he would have retired to Mar-a-Lago and worked on lowering his handicap. But he choose to run again and the ruling class came down on him like a sledgehammer, sending armed agents into his home with orders to "use deadly force in necessary" because of some silly disagreement over classified documents.
A jury convicted him of sexual assault without a scintilla of evidence. A corrupt judge imposed a half billion dollar fine on him for inflating real estate assets even though the judge admitted no bank lost a penny. He is even looking at 134 years in prison for having a tryst with a porn star twenty years ago (which he denies) and using questionable bookkeeping methods to pay her off. Trump dodged all these bullets and then he dodged a real bullet despite a Secret Service was too incompetent to protect him.
Polls showed him neck-and-neck with Biden, but the ruling class and the toady media suckered Trump into debating their sock puppet President Biden because they feared a debate a month before the election would expose his dementia that they had lied out of their teeth to hide.
Trump took the bait, and Biden was too confused to realize he had been set up. With his dementia exposed, the ruling class swatted him like a gnat and replaced him with the new sock puppet de jure Kamala Harris. Not one person voted for her for President.
Harris hid from the Press but then emerged poised and polished and vanquished the easily rattled Trump in a debate by posing as a moderate Republican instead the radical leftist she really is.
But it is unlikely that this debate changed many minds and 2024 could be a repeat of 2020, with Trump ahead on election night and the Democratic apparatus in the swing states dumping so many dubiously obtained ballots that even Bridgeport Mayor Joe Gamin will blush when he observes it.
Harris will win unless the Supreme Court steps in and stops this theft. And if she does, the country will soon realize she lied out of her teeth. She will ban fracking. She will allow illegals to flood the country. She will impose EV mandates costing taxpayers a fortune. And she will try to confiscate guns. And the billionaires who financed her will censor dissention.
Only Donald Trump can stop this. And if he doesn't, we will soon see how much mendacity the American people can tolerate, and what thuggish methods Harris will use to suppress them.

body:
I'm asking top Democrats like you to join me and speak out now
| | | | | **_USPS ALERT: Trump appointee Louis DeJoy doubles down on disastrous policies, plans to make the Postal Service MORE expensive and LESS efficient._**
---
Friend, the USPS has been in trouble for _years,_ and Postmaster General Louis DeJoy has only further damaged this fundamental and vital institution. His changes have hurt mail-in voting and slowed the delivery of lifesaving medications — all while making services _more_ expensive.
To make matters worse, DeJoy unveiled his plans at a Postal Service Board of Governors meeting, making it clear that he's doubling down on his disastrous policies. He's increased the price of stamps twice this year _ _ — all while cutting more jobs and closing more post offices!

It's no secret that this guy is bad news. Like his close ally Donald Trump, DeJoy has faced scandal after scandal — including an investigation by the FBI. With him in charge, the USPS as we know it will be GONE in the near future. We've got to do everything we can to stop him from doing any more damage.
**That's why I'm asking top Democrats like you to join me and speak out _now_ to let the Board of Governors know what you think of DeJoy's leadership. I'm counting on at least 21 more responses from 03264 by midnight, so please, friend, will you take a moment to share your crucial input?**
| | **TELL US NOW: What grade would YOU give Postmaster General Louis DeJoy?**
