A few months ago Meta removed my article on Israel and Palestine, and I received my first ever Meta warning for allegedly violating their anti-hate conduct. [I wrote about that censorship here](https://substack.com/redirect/921db64e-4f4f-44cb-bb52-f6a05cdbf3ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), pointing out that my reporting was explicitly in citing human rights law to criticize the acts of governments, and by no means violating the rights of any protected class of human beings. [Human Rights Watch has blasted Meta](https://substack.com/redirect/f296f46d-ae09-45ac-9c68-45bb429171d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for their bias and unwarranted censorship of articles calling for justice for Palestine.
Now, Meta is removing and stifling my content related to combatting racism and white supremacy. Meta's censorship ant-racist content makes absolutely no sense, and we cannot let it go unaddressed. **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=148663317&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4NjYzMzE3LCJpYXQiOjE3MjYxNzAzOTMsImV4cCI6MTcyODc2MjM5MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.S-oruqyAHD6jZCjNYh46lGCtSuVI1c8e7tTaR5N1ICo)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b783a655-3e01-45a1-b6c4-ffac46c24896?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I felt compelled to write this update because it is critical my readers know what we're up against. In 2017, a detailed analysis by ProPublica of Facebook's censorship rules [found that](https://substack.com/redirect/a28c5b5b-4356-4784-afff-fc7e425d1c38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The company's hate-speech rules tend to favor elites and governments over grassroots activists and racial minorities. In so doing, they serve the business interests of the global company, which relies on national governments not to block its service to their citizens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8888ff60-023f-4fbf-8dfa-a21d45d38eea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..a_n9bbvofslhM0GsP-Vl_iY_qr8LlaYIV_Vul1tmFKc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148663317)
It seems that nothing has changed since. Given this unjust double standard, I am not surprised that Meta is censoring my content calling out white supremacy and racism. Facebook has provided no explanation on what anti-racist remark violated what community standard? Instead, as several of my supporters reported, Facebook repeatedly removed my content any time it was shared, all without explanation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8f75cec-ddb2-46ad-bb39-66bbe95dd48f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Below I share the video Facebook continues to censor and remove from its platform. As you watch this video, you'll notice that my commentary is based in fact and history (and some comedy), and certainly not in any form of propaganda or demonization.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5e54ff81-3038-49b5-9d87-20d0d4cad4f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
You'll note that I cite America's history of anti-Black, anti-Asian, anti-immigrant, anti-Muslim, and antisemitic discrimination--all to prove the point that such discrimination still exists today. And to prove that such discrimination won't end unless we confront it directly. And Meta chose to restrict and prevent even that dialogue. Unfortunately, Facebook has a [history of enabling genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/ebaca6a2-04f0-4dde-9439-481609882663?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and censoring criticism of those committing genocide or engaging in racism. So it is no surprise that they are once again on the wrong side of history.

Derek, JB Pritzker here, Governor of Illinois. This should only take a minute or two of your time, but it’s critically important.

When Lisa made history as the first woman and person of color to represent Delaware in Congress, her work immediately spoke for itself. She's been a fearless advocate on issues like reproductive rights, economic justice, and climate change.
Lisa is the perfect example of why we need greater representation in the Senate because she knows how to get the job done. Here’s the problem: Black women candidates raise on average one-third of what their white counterparts do.
That’s why Republicans have their eyes set on flipping this vulnerable seat, and they’ll invest heavily to try to make it happen – but we can stop them. Attacks are already being pummeled from Breitbart to Ben Shapiro and a Tucker Carlson wannabe, so Lisa is counting on us to have her back.

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1bab813c70c44dab65041f23280b961&_e=hPcvxhKewyoxtFf4CmT0gOVft0y-_zqpvHOXNK6QZR2E6BVyIk2AJfbt_CYRrLgAR18R49V0Q-GUIoHDM4_EoUdbU_4rjwDAdSJEU0bELbhLrV5EaVdXRK9aRtL2WXZtynMLN3weIGpgefQmeJDvBV7Ov6prXP0_txwzDLd-Yy5ZIW3CZfQ9JBI_lvBsP39dIq8Wa5V0fQdD6JVKunqn8trKgs_Wkeu93wGyOzu8D3rr5jrvUZDOg0sWMQc6h3Uk2TXNhnknUd_w83KTZGldxvDHXb_wCRfyxu5rPp1yw5cQQOAmDLIHoj4msheDm4hp4PAK3O7hqCX7V806XE9zADTwp3VJPJblhpTmwKexrBzmIz0Rrg5TTVPv6wqP86LB-L_XdjwwKcmDd2pQfuKkPN19B6rJqoFuyCa1MnSRGPo%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1bab813c70c44dab65041f23280b961&_e=hPcvxhKewyoxtFf4CmT0gOVft0y-_zqpvHOXNK6QZR2E6BVyIk2AJfbt_CYRrLgAR18R49V0Q-GUIoHDM4_EoUdbU_4rjwDAdSJEU0bELbhLrV5EaVdXRK9aRtL2WXZtynMLN3weIGpgefQmeJDvBV7Ov6prXP0_txwzDLd-Yy5ZIW3CZfQ9JBI_lvBsP39dIq8Wa5V0fQdD6JVKunqn8trKgs_Wkeu93wGyOzu8D3rr5jrvUZDOg0sWMQc6h3Uk8T6WNbR8rPUAGEL4JiLe1YhyCAYnna5U7dqRNCo61j9vYb5oz0i4VxD-bOD1PgQdbIqL9AY5XA-yf48YvCu_voTY0nP-GMUv4t3ccZOHHZBY5Q40xU03IcCcWC6CVwUuoF5BeJv3xX0S8IpmPgoBuUtSYijeoEzZtU2-gdZMnQ0%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1bab813c70c44dab65041f23280b961&_e=hPcvxhKewyoxtFf4CmT0gOVft0y-_zqpvHOXNK6QZR2E6BVyIk2AJfbt_CYRrLgAR18R49V0Q-GUIoHDM4_EoUdbU_4rjwDAdSJEU0bELbhLrV5EaVdXRK9aRtL2WXZtynMLN3weIGpgefQmeJDvBV7Ov6prXP0_txwzDLd-Yy5ZIW3CZfQ9JBI_lvBsP39dIq8Wa5V0fQdD6JVKunqn8trKgs_Wkeu93wGyOzu8D3rr5jrvUZDOg0sWMQc6h3UkQ_lSRzL8hNdV-fD_2Y0ivEWltqTMCBM5wll8yh5b30KoJOGN0KZ3sv2Qf34yKq8iRCXXarKm8ISEPwP1tNr96MphIcMiUCBfba2nzGQ60CC2j_kZaR7Fi8fKfwBnzdP14FRYnHdvViBOiTpmwQ1dQ5GTQPFRz9U2NY130zD1quY%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

| Dear Fellow American,

I want to take _just a moment_ of your time to help you understand how vital the support that Judicial Watch receives from our members is...not just for Judicial Watch, but, more importantly, for our country.
You see, Judicial Watch is helping fight _against_ public corruption and _for_ the American people's right to know what its government is doing!
_And thanks to our members and supporters_ , no one fights _corrupt politicians in both parties_ as hard as Judicial Watch and no one in Washington matches _our effectiveness_.
But our work carries _very real costs_ with it, and that's [**why I hope you decide to give us your support today.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70117&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

Please understand that our work is _essential_ :

* We continue to fight daily in federal courts across the country to keep our elections honest...**_and we are prepared for whatever challenges confront our nation and the rule of law as a result of the November 5th national elections_**

* We're aggressively exposing the **Biden-Harris administration 's weaponization of federal****agencies** to target and silence conservatives and other political opponents..._and election results will have no impact on our commitment to getting to all the facts and forcing accountability for this profound corruption of our government_

| | I'm Mike McCall, the Director of Experiments at Movement Labs, and that means I'm a behind-the-scenes guy. I'm not usually writing you emails, but I'll give this a shot. **I lead a team that runs tests and collects data that directly impacts how we show up to help and engage voters like you in red, rural, and local elections.** At Movement Labs, we're always innovating, thinking ahead, and trying to get out in front of problems that could keep voters from casting their ballots. And in this election, we can't afford to lose a single vote to tuned-out voters, misinformation, or sneaky Republicans purging voter rolls. Trump and Vance are dangerous, and they're bullies. So, when you mobilize thousands of supporters, target voters, throw big events, show up in unexpected places, get people double-checking their voter registrations, and on top of that, call them out for what they really are – weirdos – they freeze up. I first got involved as a canvasser back in college during the 2004 presidential election. I toughed it out on the doors and the phones back then, and I am even more committed now to putting in the long hours, going over the data one more time, and trying out new ideas to get our folks to the polls to keep Trump and Vance out of the White House. And the data doesn't lie. Our tests show that when we thoughtfully target supporters, mobilize activists, and re-engage folks who've been left behind by big-name national groups, they come out to vote in droves. **We're raising vote margins in places where there's going to be a paper-thin difference. And that one or two percent advantage means the difference between Kamala Harris and Tim Walz or Donald Trump and J.D. Vance.** We can keep the Senate, retake the House, kick election-denying state reps out of office, and change the direction of our country by electing new leaders in November. I'm so excited to be a part of making this happen! Thanks for supporting us along the way, _Mike_ Mike McCall

clean_body: | | | | I'm Mike McCall, the Director of Experiments at Movement Labs, and that means I'm a behind-the-scenes guy. I'm not usually writing you emails, but I'll give this a shot. I lead a team that runs tests and collects data that directly impacts how we show up to help and engage voters like you in red, rural, and local elections. At Movement Labs, we're always innovating, thinking ahead, and trying to get out in front of problems that could keep voters from casting their ballots. And in this election, we can't afford to lose a single vote to tuned-out voters, misinformation, or sneaky Republicans purging voter rolls. Trump and Vance are dangerous, and they're bullies. So, when you mobilize thousands of supporters, target voters, throw big events, show up in unexpected places, get people double-checking their voter registrations, and on top of that, call them out for what they really are – weirdos – they freeze up. I first got involved as a canvasser back in college during the 2004 presidential election. I toughed it out on the doors and the phones back then, and I am even more committed now to putting in the long hours, going over the data one more time, and trying out new ideas to get our folks to the polls to keep Trump and Vance out of the White House. And the data doesn't lie. Our tests show that when we thoughtfully target supporters, mobilize activists, and re-engage folks who've been left behind by big-name national groups, they come out to vote in droves. We're raising vote margins in places where there's going to be a paper-thin difference. And that one or two percent advantage means the difference between Kamala Harris and Tim Walz or Donald Trump and J.D. Vance. We can keep the Senate, retake the House, kick election-denying state reps out of office, and change the direction of our country by electing new leaders in November. I'm so excited to be a part of making this happen! Hi folks,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re under 60 days away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multimillionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.
We can’t write our campaigns million-dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: you. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers – you name it – who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.

We are facing a critical moment in the Pennsylvania Senate race.

With only a few days to go until the first votes are cast in the Keystone State, CNN released a poll showing **a TIED RACE (46% -46%) between Dave McCormick and Bob Casey, underscoring just how fiercely competitive this race has become.**

The Center for Reproductive Rights has more than 20 active cases in the United States right now fighting to protect reproductive rights— | "MATCH YOUR GIFT" Your support is critical right now as we build on this momentum in states like Idaho and Tennessee, where similar bans are threatening the lives and rights of countless pregnant people. Sarah Harte and her daughters, Caroline Harte, Julia Sairam, and Anna-Brooke Gutzler stepped up because they know that reproductive rights are worth fighting for. "JOIN THE FIGHT x2" This ruling in North Dakota is a monumental step forward. However, the damage that the state’s extreme abortion bans have done cannot be repaired overnight. While hospitals and doctors will no longer have their hands tied and will be able to provide abortions to patients with pregnancy complications, there are no abortion clinics left in North Dakota. That means most people seeking an abortion still won’t be able to get one, even though it is legal. We need your support now more than ever to ensure that we can continue to shore up protections for abortion rights across the U.S. and around the world. Thank you for your unwavering support, Meetra Mehdizadeh Staff Attorney P.S. P.S. Our work isn't over—18 states currently ban abortion completely or after six weeks of pregnancy, before many know they are pregnant. "DONATE NOW" | | | | ---|---|--- The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. body:
If you're anything like us, your inbox and cell phone are full of fundraising requests from different campaigns and organizations.
---
Why the Democratic National Committee? Why today? If you're anything like us, your inbox and cell phone are full of fundraising requests from campaigns and organizations. Please give us a chance to make the case for why your donation to the Democratic Party is the most important one you can make if you want to see Democrats win this November. Here is the truth: First, we know you want to make sure that your donation will actually go toward the outcome you want: electing Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats across the country. The Democratic National Committee is the head of the Democratic Party. Electing Democrats is what we do. So you can trust that your donation is going where you want it. The DNC is also the organization best positioned to move resources where they are needed, when they are needed most. We can make investments in grassroots organizing, state parties, our technology infrastructure, and all the resources candidates in every ZIP code across the country need to compete and win. There may be nowhere else you can get the bang for your buck that you can with a donation to the DNC. So if you're a Democrat looking to make a difference and are wondering where your donation will go the furthest, we're asking: [**Can Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats everywhere count on you to contribute $3 -- whatever you can afford -- directly to the Democratic National Committee today? body:
President Biden announced a historic executive action to strengthen the Violence Against Women Act
#

This is BIG news:
**Today, on the 30th anniversary of the Violence Against Women Act, President Biden announced a historic executive action to strengthen the Violence Against Women Act and end gender-based violence. This new executive action will help states allocate funding to keep guns out of the hands of abusers.**
This is an important step to keep women safe from violence. Firearms are the most common weapons used in domestic violence homicides, and the mere presence of a gun in a domestic violence situation makes it five times more likely that a woman will be killed. Just know that by supporting GIFFORDS PAC and our work to keep guns out of the hands of domestic abusers, you helped make this progress possible.
[**We need you with us to keep moving forward. Will you make a $3 contribution in honor of this historic executive action from the Biden-Harris administration to strengthen the Violence Against Women Act?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240912-1-30&t=1&akid=8925%2E3935704%2EhqFC4l)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240912-1-30&t=2&akid=8925%2E3935704%2EhqFC4l)**
President Biden authored the Violence Against Women Act as a senator 30 years ago, and we’re thankful for his decades of leadership in the important work to keep women safe from preventable violence.
As we look towards the future, we know that Vice President Kamala Harris is ready to carry on Joe Biden’s legacy and work tirelessly to keep women safe. We are so proud to support her in her campaign for president.
When we elect Vice President Harris and Governor Tim Walz this November, we need to have the resources to make more progress like we saw with today’s executive action.
[**So please, will you help fuel our lifesaving work at GIFFORDS PAC by making a $3 contribution today?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240912-1-30&t=3&akid=8925%2E3935704%2EhqFC4l)

**" Residents hear shots in downtown Dallas, police responding,"** Dallas Morning News' **Aria Jones** ,**Jamie Landers** ,**Claire Ballor** and**Matt Kyle** -- "Three people were wounded in a shooting Thursday afternoon in [downtown Dallas](https://substack.com/redirect/87d86b7b-92ea-44d0-935a-d999c7887fa4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), police say.

A police spokeswoman said just before 3 p.m. that the three were taken to hospitals, but their conditions were unknown. No information about the suspect was available, she said.

Police said officers responded about 12:15 p.m. to the 1800 block of Commerce Street, near South St. Paul Street. More than 20 police units responded to the shooting Thursday afternoon, according to an online police call log. Police at a news conference declined to take further questions, citing an active investigation.

Dallas Fire-Rescue also responded to the Continental building and sent multiple units, two of which took patients to hospitals, a spokesman said. Residents of the building told _The Dallas Morning News_ that they heard more than a dozen shots.

_This election isn’t just about our future, but our children's futures._ The contrast between the choice before us on Tuesday night could not have been clearer:

**On climate change:**
* Kamala Harris has consistently pushed for action. She knows it’s a serious threat to our country, our planet, and to our children’s futures.
* Donald Trump has called climate change a **_hoax_** and continues to downplay this very real crisis.

**On healthcare:**
* Kamala Harris knows that healthcare is a _right_ , not a privilege — she already has a track record of making lifesaving medicines more accessible and affordable. She will continue to strengthen the Affordable Care Act for families.
* After 9 years of campaigning, Trump claims to have only the “concepts of a plan” to address healthcare but we can’t forget his repeated attempts to sabotage the ACA, leaving millions of Americans – including children – uninsured.

**On children and families:**
* Kamala Harris is fighting for policies like expanding the child tax credit and strengthening our public school systems.
* Trump’s Project 2025 agenda doesn’t mention child care at all. Instead, it calls for **_eliminating the Department of Education_** and preschool programs that give our kids a strong start.

It’s pretty simple: Trump and MAGA Republicans are eager to dismantle progress and take us backwards. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are determined to build a future where every child has access to healthcare, education, and a safe planet to call home.

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=8d23a1b33b674b84b4100083981834b2&_e=S5wqolJDiaRnCOQY527dKy0bYNo6wuMBt5Dw5fBTeAmaX1d1ID23ePxMBm6NuPv7X0Cp9p2gUOg-qPzfiZDrN9uEtbb8GX4Nqj_R3GtcM2ZG75G_-1e-OtmIJiDAIRGkq2QrQpHTXEUae5l2kHdJVE00KuFzqaE3552J1TlZOSR5gexWpuXt40MtnJOt77XBTGCeZ5KNv_ilFz87quswCpQfcemeIur9DKc5M19bHkXEDhVinB-sMWlUGDa9IJKujHoXv05mi-gixak5S_plOisMbbw8W6RNAgnmRaSOQOhFH7MMbudGDaVNQB5k3GgCu-Yymr67d-r1XqxJdX4oMojRb209LpJ6mzqwcpZO4NK9vTTeM-h9qSfL85yVU92A5_-qzs7WiolTCjfEtCNGUCJMsy77RyFj2zwHA5z_ZfU%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=8d23a1b33b674b84b4100083981834b2&_e=S5wqolJDiaRnCOQY527dKy0bYNo6wuMBt5Dw5fBTeAmaX1d1ID23ePxMBm6NuPv7X0Cp9p2gUOg-qPzfiZDrN9uEtbb8GX4Nqj_R3GtcM2ZG75G_-1e-OtmIJiDAIRGkq2QrQpHTXEUae5l2kHdJVE00KuFzqaE3552J1TlZOSR5gexWpuXt40MtnJOt77XBTGCeZ5KNv_ilFz87quswCpQfcemeIur9DKc5M19bHkXEDhVinB-sMWlUGDa9IJKujHoXv05mi-gixak5S_plOrZBLT9gpEapKrthJYgwnMzuUsNPDqUtqymUZCbBzYthhNzOCwuK_zFLCjpRB6CdPwMQ09rU62OIptFlkmpjcOotKQWhY84uzPk5ZJFE13VE-clZresKzs-gPKFbRes9tt2y43H966ebuhTYt0C23lQ%3D)**

Care is on the ballot, and we need you with us.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92698108/497999646/664783965?ms=091224_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDVhOWQwYy00YzcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BzlfkH7Pj76UjoLXlxlY3ZHOFfCJ_2f59-z3eixAdvk=&emci=eaedc5f8-1871-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=a45a9d0c-4c71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
Tuesday night’s debate between Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump in Philadelphia made one thing extremely clear: **Kamala Harris has a plan to deliver for you while Donald Trump is still thinking about himself.**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92698110/497999648/950297961?ms=091224_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDVhOWQwYy00YzcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BzlfkH7Pj76UjoLXlxlY3ZHOFfCJ_2f59-z3eixAdvk=&emci=eaedc5f8-1871-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=a45a9d0c-4c71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
As millions of Americans tuned in, they heard two distinct visions for the country: One focused on uplifting working families through a **strong care infrastructure** , and the other **ignoring the vital role of caregiving** in our society.
[**_We can’t afford to go backwards, Peter — will you pledge to help elect Kamala Harris and other Care Champions in this final stretch before the election?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92698112/497999650/950297961?ms=091224_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDVhOWQwYy00YzcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BzlfkH7Pj76UjoLXlxlY3ZHOFfCJ_2f59-z3eixAdvk=&emci=eaedc5f8-1871-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=a45a9d0c-4c71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
[SIGN THE PLEDGE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92698114/497999652/950297961?ms=091224_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDVhOWQwYy00YzcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BzlfkH7Pj76UjoLXlxlY3ZHOFfCJ_2f59-z3eixAdvk=&emci=eaedc5f8-1871-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=a45a9d0c-4c71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
On Tuesday night, Kamala Harris **reaffirmed her leadership as the champion working families need.** She laid out her vision for an 'opportunity economy,' emphasizing the vital importance of care infrastructure including an expanded Child Tax Credit. And she knows the difficult choices women in this country are facing, like having to find ways to pay for child care while traveling across state lines to access essential health care.
In contrast, Donald Trump is out of touch with the struggles of working families, **failing to address these critical issues.** Instead he deflected questions, criminalized immigrants, and talked about his rally crowd sizes.
_So this is it, Peter: We’re in a sprint to protect the care agenda from now until Election Day._
**We need to fight for an economy that cares for workers and families, and lifts everyone up.**
[**_If you’re with us and ready to fight for care workers and families, pledge now to do everything you can to support Kamala Harris and other Care Champions this November:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92698116/497999656/950297961?ms=091224_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDVhOWQwYy00YzcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BzlfkH7Pj76UjoLXlxlY3ZHOFfCJ_2f59-z3eixAdvk=&emci=eaedc5f8-1871-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=a45a9d0c-4c71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

clean_body: Care is on the ballot, and we need you with us. Hi Peter, Tuesday night’s debate between Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump in Philadelphia made one thing extremely clear: Kamala Harris has a plan to deliver for you while Donald Trump is still thinking about himself. As millions of Americans tuned in, they heard two distinct visions for the country: One focused on uplifting working families through a strong care infrastructure , and the other ignoring the vital role of caregiving in our society. On Tuesday night, Kamala Harris reaffirmed her leadership as the champion working families need. She laid out her vision for an 'opportunity economy,' emphasizing the vital importance of care infrastructure including an expanded Child Tax Credit. And she knows the difficult choices women in this country are facing, like having to find ways to pay for child care while traveling across state lines to access essential health care. In contrast, Donald Trump is out of touch with the struggles of working families, failing to address these critical issues. Instead he deflected questions, criminalized immigrants, and talked about his rally crowd sizes. So this is it, Peter: We’re in a sprint to protect the care agenda from now until Election Day. We need to fight for an economy that cares for workers and families, and lifts everyone up. Stay tuned and we’ll keep you updated on more ways to take action during this critical final stretch. In solidarity, Hillary Holley Executive Director | Care in Action

#
Tonight, I’m debating my Republican opponent for the first time since I became the Democratic nominee to represent Delaware in Congress — and I’m jumping out of debate prep to send this.
**To show our strength, our campaign just set an ambitious goal to bring in 250 grassroots donations before I take the stage.**
[**Will you give $5 or more right now ahead of tonight’s critical debate to help us reach our goal? Any amount you can spare will go a long way!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240912-2?refcode=em20240912-2-1193&amount=5&refcode2=1193_21716_DlupyW&akid=1193%2E21716%2EDlupyW)
I call Delaware a “state of neighbors,” and I’m excited to take the stage to share with my neighbors why I’m fighting for paid family and medical leave, affordable child care, gun safety and reproductive freedom, and how I’ll fight for them in Washington _every single day._
But we can’t ignore the threat from our opponent, the right-wing media, and super PACs: They’re raising money in the hopes of drowning out all of that and making us scared of our differences instead of empowered by them.
I know that through the power of our proximity, we can fight back against the culture wars, open some of the most closed-off hearts and minds, and break through some of the perverse, base incentives in our politics.
**That’s the message I’ll be sharing tonight, and one I can only spread to undecided voters across Delaware with your help:** [**Will you invest $5 or more right now before I take the debate stage tonight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240912-2?refcode=em20240912-2-1193&amount=5&refcode2=1193_21716_DlupyW&akid=1193%2E21716%2EDlupyW)

Sarah

| Peter,

This week, we watched the first major Presidential Debate between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump. Here’s the truth: there were some great and not-so-great moments from the debate that prepared us for what is ahead of us.

_**Here are some highlights from the debate:**_
* Vice President Kamala Harris eloquently presented her vision for our country and gave us a glimpse at what our future would look like under her leadership – she shared personal stories and reaffirmed that the right to abortion is a decision between a person and their doctor, not a politician’s.

* Donald Trump spread lies about “post-birth” abortions (which are not even real!) and says that it should be up to the states to decide a person’s bodily autonomy.

* VP Harris showed her strong policy acumen and addressed the issues impacting everyday Americans, including expanding access to affordable health care and child care.

* Convicted felon Donald Trump said that he has “concepts of a plan” when asked to lay out his plan of action for the American people. He instead praised dictators and reminded us of the dangers under his presidency.

**Our goal is clear** – We cannot let Donald Trump and his MAGA allies win and overthrow our democracy. With Vice President Kamala Harris and Gov. Walz at the top of the ticket, we must support Democratic women to get to the finish line and flip critical seats across the country so that they can work together and deliver progress for every American.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Last week marked a painful anniversary for me and my family.
On September 5th, 2000, my beloved aunt was murdered by her husband – a victim of domestic violence like millions of Americans.
Losing her was d evastating – she was taken from us far too soon.
As a survivor of domestic violence myself, I know that abuse is still too prevalent in our society, especially since we have two sex offenders on the Supreme Court, one running to become President of the United States, and his VP pick telling women to stay with their abusers.
I know that silence gives abusers a place to hide, so I am determined to use my voice to call out both abusers and abuse enablers like Jim Jordan. I will never let my opponent or anyone else forget that Jim Jordan didn’t do a damn thing to protect HIS recruits from being sexually abused. No, instead he participated in unethical behavior.
In 2022 and 2023, Ohio experienced two of the worst years on record for intimate partner violence. Yet, Jim Jordan has repeatedly voted against the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) every single time it has come up for a vote since he’s been in Congress.
I’ll be blunt. Treating women's safety as an afterthought has deadly consequences for ALL victims of domestic violence, but Jim Jordan clearly doesn’t give a damn about women or our safety.
That’s why I’m asking for your support today. We’re raising $1 million this month to ensure every voter in Ohio knows that Jim Jordan has failed victims, survivors, and women like me. We need to spread the word and hold him accountable. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240912_tamies_aunt_link1]
Jim Jordan’s disregard for survivors doesn’t stop with his voting record. I will never stop talking about his shameful role in the Ohio State University sexual abuse scandal, where he ignored the pleas of his young recruits who were victims of sexual abuse under his watch – choosing instead to turn the other way.
Jordan has shown time and again that protecting people from violence, whether it’s women, survivors of domestic violence, or even college students, isn’t his priority.
He’s more interested in maintaining a ULTRA-MAGA power structure where women remain subservient, diminished, unsafe, and weak.
His stance on these issues isn’t just out of touch – it’s life-threatening.
I’ve spent my life fighting to protect women and survivors, whether through my advocacy or my work on legislation that addresses abuse.
I’m not even elected yet, and I’ve already authored a bipartisan bill, The Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act , which focuses on expanding protections for survivors of abuse and holding perpetrators accountable.
This bill is on its way to passing—which is more than Jim Jordan has done in 17 years in Congress. That’s the difference between someone who’s here to get results and someone who’s in it for the headlines.
This race isn’t just about defeating Jim Jordan—it’s about showing survivors that we believe them, that they deserve justice, and that they matter.
I am running to honor the memory of my aunt.
I am running to make sure we never have to face the devastating consequences of neglecting women's safety again.
We need leaders who will stand up for survivors, not ignore them. Together, we can flip OH-04 and elect someone who will fight for women’s safety, not undermine it. Every contribution helps us get closer to making this a reality. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240912_tamies_aunt_link2]
Together, let’s bring real change to Congress and protect those who need it most.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

As a survivor of domestic violence myself, I know that abuse is still too prevalent in our society, especially since we have two sex offenders on the Supreme Court, one running to become President of the United States, and his VP pick telling women to stay with their abusers. I know that silence gives abusers a place to hide, so I am determined to use my voice to call out both abusers and abuse enablers like Jim Jordan. I will never let my opponent or anyone else forget that Jim Jordan didn’t do a damn thing to protect HIS recruits from being sexually abused. No, instead he participated in unethical behavior. In 2022 and 2023, Ohio experienced two of the worst years on record for intimate partner violence. Yet, Jim Jordan has repeatedly voted against the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) every single time it has come up for a vote since he’s been in Congress. I’ll be blunt. Treating women's safety as an afterthought has deadly consequences for ALL victims of domestic violence, but Jim Jordan clearly doesn’t give a damn about women or our safety. That’s why I’m asking for your support today. We’re raising $1 million this month to ensure every voter in Ohio knows that Jim Jordan has failed victims, survivors, and women like me. We need to spread the word and hold him accountable. [] Jim Jordan’s disregard for survivors doesn’t stop with his voting record. I will never stop talking about his shameful role in the Ohio State University sexual abuse scandal, where he ignored the pleas of his young recruits who were victims of sexual abuse under his watch – choosing instead to turn the other way. Jordan has shown time and again that protecting people from violence, whether it’s women, survivors of domestic violence, or even college students, isn’t his priority. He’s more interested in maintaining a ULTRA-MAGA power structure where women remain subservient, diminished, unsafe, and weak. His stance on these issues isn’t just out of touch – it’s life-threatening. I’ve spent my life fighting to protect women and survivors, whether through my advocacy or my work on legislation that addresses abuse. I’m not even elected yet, and I’ve already authored a bipartisan bill, The Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act , which focuses on expanding protections for survivors of abuse and holding perpetrators accountable. This bill is on its way to passing—which is more than Jim Jordan has done in 17 years in Congress. That’s the difference between someone who’s here to get results and someone who’s in it for the headlines. This race isn’t just about defeating Jim Jordan—it’s about showing survivors that we believe them, that they deserve justice, and that they matter. I am running to honor the memory of my aunt. I am running to make sure we never have to face the devastating consequences of neglecting women's safety again. We need leaders who will stand up for survivors, not ignore them. Together, we can flip OH-04 and elect someone who will fight for women’s safety, not undermine it. Every contribution helps us get closer to making this a reality. DRAIN THE SWAMP
We're Shaking Up Washington—
Join Me
Dear Peter,
Everyone has heard President Trump’s signature phrase, Drain the Swamp. His instinct is spot on. The problem in Washington isn’t just a few corrupt individuals. _It is a whole corrupt system._
**It’s the federal agencies. It’s the lobbyists. It’s the research organizations, it’s the media, and it’s the corporations.**
Well, I’ve spent 40 years suing almost all of them. In many of these agencies, I know the names of the bad actors who need to be moved out. I understand the perverse incentives that put agency capture on steroids.
I know how the system is supposed to work to protect the public interest and how it actually works to protect the mercantile interests of the regulated industries that have captured it. **AND I know how to fix it**. And that is exactly what I am going to do with Donald Trump’s backing.
Let me tell you what we are going to do
**We are going to:**
* **Appoint** honest officials who don’t have conflicts of interest.
* **Listen** to whistleblowers and act on their revelations.
* **Slam shut** the revolving door that sends industry executives and lobbyists in and out of government.
* **Fire** anyone who betrays the public trust or lies to the public.
* **Prohibit** federal agencies from using their powers to harass political opponents.

**That’s what it means to drain the swamp.**
One of my top priorities in Washington will be to make sure President Trump can follow through on his promise and return us to a government OF THE PEOPLE.
[But I can’t do this without your support.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=drain_the_swamp_9_12_24_all_1&n=5)

Be assured, I will take bold action to challenge the corruption entrenched in Washington and disrupt the power structures that have failed the American people for far too long.

clean_body: | | | | | | | DRAIN THE SWAMP We're Shaking Up Washington— Join Me Dear Peter, Everyone has heard President Trump’s signature phrase, Drain the Swamp. His instinct is spot on. The problem in Washington isn’t just a few corrupt individuals. It is a whole corrupt system. It’s the federal agencies. It’s the lobbyists. It’s the research organizations, it’s the media, and it’s the corporations. Well, I’ve spent 40 years suing almost all of them. In many of these agencies, I know the names of the bad actors who need to be moved out. I understand the perverse incentives that put agency capture on steroids. I know how the system is supposed to work to protect the public interest and how it actually works to protect the mercantile interests of the regulated industries that have captured it. AND I know how to fix it. And that is exactly what I am going to do with Donald Trump’s backing. Let me tell you what we are going to do We are going to: Appoint honest officials who don’t have conflicts of interest. Listen to whistleblowers and act on their revelations. Slam shut the revolving door that sends industry executives and lobbyists in and out of government. Fire anyone who betrays the public trust or lies to the public. Prohibit federal agencies from using their powers to harass political opponents. That’s what it means to drain the swamp.** One of my top priorities in Washington will be to make sure President Trump can follow through on his promise and return us to a government OF THE PEOPLE. Be assured, I will take bold action to challenge the corruption entrenched in Washington and disrupt the power structures that have failed the American people for far too long. to ensure I can help drain the swamp and restore government of the people. Thank you for standing strong with me for the future of America. | | Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. | | ©2024 • • • • PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY | | PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY P.O. As a Californian, I treasure our beloved fast-food chain.This wildly successful business should be a true indicator of California's success and brilliance. Unfortunately, even a business so beloved is not immune to Democrat economic and law enforcement policies.Those same policies bring about headlines such as this: In-N-Out was forced to close its first restaurant ever because of the rampant crime in Oakland. The Democrats who did this to our state and to Oakland should be ashamed.I called for the Oakland Mayor to resign, and I called for Adam Schiff to join me - But unsurprisingly he's silent on the issue.That's because Adam Schiff, Gavin Newsom, and Sheng Thao are all part of the same Democrat machine driving California out of prosperity and into the ground. Fellow American, I think it's time we go "Animal-Style" on Adam Schiff. Your contributions to my campaign show your support and a complete rejection of the 4-decade Democrat-Rule in California. | Peter,

My parents came here to seek a better life for their family, just like so many others. As one of seven children and a first-generation American, I was raised on the values of hard work and resilience–lessons that have shaped every step of my journey.

**As a labor attorney, I fought for workers who had been exploited and mistreated–people who were doing everything they could to provide for their families yet still struggling to make ends meet. But I knew more needed to be done.**

That’s why I followed my sister’s footsteps and ran for Congress!

**Since I was elected, I’ve fought for fair wages, affordable healthcare and housing, protecting Social Security and Medicare, reforming our tax code, and supporting small businesses–all with the goal of improving life for hardworking families like mine.**

But I can’t do this alone. Extremists are actively working to cut these essential programs, strip workers of their rights, and roll back the progress we’ve fought so hard to make. We need to stand together.

We wanted to take a meow-ment to introduce you to the four newest (and furriest) members of the O’Rouke family:
Beto is leaving the kittens and chickens behind (don’t worry, Molly will take great care of them while he’s gone!) and setting out on the road to visit every major college campus across Texas.

Hi friend,

In honor of National Report Medicare Fraud Day, I want to take a moment to share why protecting Medicare is so important:
Medicare is a vital government program that provides millions of Floridians access to affordable health care coverage — but each year, it loses roughly $60 billion due to fraud, errors, and abuse.
The system we have in place is not perfect, friend — I know that firsthand. As my mom's primary caretaker, I know how complicated it can be to navigate the Medicare system. It makes ensuring my mom can age with dignity and comfort that much more challenging.

**But I also know the critical role it plays in my mom's life and in the lives of our seniors across the country. **
That's the thing, friend: **We need to _invest in_ these vital government programs, not cut them down or take advantage of them. And if Rick Scott had it his way, that's exactly what he'd do (or continue doing). **
Rick Scott is a scammer and a thief who's responsible for one of the largest Medicare fraud scandals in U.S. history. To add insult to injury, he then went on to write the plan to DEFUND Medicare — _a plan that would put the lives of millions at risk._

It's devastating and, frankly, disgusting how someone would put their own profit and personal gain above the lives of real people. I've spent my career fighting to expand health care access for Americans and to protect our seniors, and I am sick and tired of seeing politicians like Rick Scott make these selfish decisions.
Expanding access to Medicare is one of my highest priorities, friend — and I plan on protecting it when I defeat Rick Scott in November. There are too many Floridians who rely on Medicare for us to let a guy who led one of the largest Medicare-related fraud scandal gut it.

Friend,
As I write this, Mike Johnson and his Deepstate cronies are getting ready to stuff another spending bill down Americans’ throats.
**Mike Johnson is _lying_ to the American people, he is _colluding_ with Chuck Schumer, and he is _selling_ our country out.**
[FIGHT FOR OUR COUNTRY](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)
I have been asking Republicans to answer the same question for almost an entire year of Mike Johnson making a mess as Speaker of the House:
**Can you name _one single victory_ that Mike Johnson has gotten for Conservatives?**
**I SURE CAN’T!**
Despite what the Media and Talking Heads say, this is NOT about ‘Republicans’ vs. ‘Democrats’.
This is about the basic principles that real Americans care about...
The principles that motivated Americans to give the GOP the House Majority. A majority they are wasting.
**This is about Mike Johnson _backing down_ to Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden _every single time_ _._**
[STAND FOR WHAT'S RIGHT](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)
This is about Mike Johnson _breaking promises_ to stop the sale of our children’s future with outrageous spending as soon as he meets with his first lobbyist.
This is about him _immediately breaking his promise to stop the endless foreign wars, pointless carnage, and death_ as soon as the first Democrat called him a nasty name on Fake News CNN.
This is about Mike Johnson _forcing you to continue funding the war_ in Ukraine while the border is open, and Americans can’t afford their mortgage payments or groceries.
This is about Mike Johnson _surrendering on securing our Elections_ through the SAVE Act so he can get a pat on the head by Hakeem Jeffries, Chuck Schumer and Kamala Harris.
**On the eve of an election, Mike Johnson is betraying you, me, and President Trump.**
[STAND FOR AMERICA](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)
**While Americans struggle, Mike Johnson is setting up fake fights, working with Democrats, and hiding from journalists.**
This isn’t about “party”: This is about the Deepstate wanting to capture every member of Congress, regardless of party affiliation, and get them in line, stepping on your rights, trampling your savings, and intimidating you if you ask ‘why?’
I think it’s pretty obvious they got Mike Johnson...
I think it’s pretty obvious they’ve got most of Congress...
**And I think the American people know they're not going to get me.**
[DEFEND MTG](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)
I am fighting like Hell against the Deepstate, against a rogue government trying to bankrupt its own citizens, and against meaningless, endless foreign conflicts.
And believe me: __**They are fighting back.**__
We are just weeks away from the most important election in the history of our country and there is not a single Member of Congress doing more to fight against the Deep State’s games than I am.
**That’s why they’ve made me their #1 target to get out of the way.**
_**[Friend, from the bottom of my heart, I would not be reaching out to you again if the situation wasn’t dire. I’ve been fighting for you for years. After having your back, can I count on you to have mine and help me resist their attacks](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)**_**?**
Everyday, I wake up and go to the Capitol, and I fight for Americans just like you...
I fight against RINOs and Democrats trying to destroy President Trump, and take away your children’s future.
**The only way they can get me to stop is if they run me out of office and they’re doing everything they can to drive me out in November.**
_**[Can I count on you](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j7-OnDAQxp9m6ED22BgoXCRZkSLS9akiY493fcKwN4age_vIq1PK-c2n74_LzzXFTwvDd0B8pFAAEdQ3QPz4fWU-3_Ovn-2bkEP7Yd5yX7_4AxCPzyf9l365dJRdWisdbk2wKgahG7JyQCNHZUzfPGz0yghagugxaOWkD0JOEbXxKEaPS5MsCtRikogKBzV1vUHlJuelGuMkhwW0eOV0LhMn72Q5Lse877nze25W-ziOZ3kVmwHnQv5k6q60MYWqAJyz4_edE7V3JtqojTu3ft_uTKUAziEsTuixH2UcI5KuRmo-j_yn7Cd7AnXb_ApoKsoU0plB3Rb-IgdxvS-WgIZrPKftDup28EkN2_C80rqmYgbQ4v6aUov_tfgvAAD__912e5w)**_**?**

Mike Johnson is lying to the American people, he is colluding with Chuck Schumer, and he is selling our country out. While Americans struggle, Mike Johnson is setting up fake fights, working with Democrats, and hiding from journalists. That’s why they’ve made me their #1 target to get out of the way. ? Everyday, I wake up and go to the Capitol, and I fight for Americans just like you... To: Top Supporters
From: Hilary Barrett, Nevada State Democratic Party
RE: In 2024, Nevada will once again be an expensive, hardfought battleground state
\--------------------------------------

Election cycle after election cycle, Nevada remains an expensive and hardfought battleground state where candidates win or lose by razor-thin field margins.
Nevada is a winnable battleground, but it requires a lot more work and investment because of the changing electorate.

**[_Make a contribution to the Nevada State Democratic Party towards the voter engagement and mobilization plan that will deliver Democratic control in Washington._](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yT0lhW6SUIBaDocFw1qIPk2ncdK2ZYzkOmTfT-On-pn90xwpuG6xMt0JDsYFPgJECIYZO06kjVaEDtbpfgxF2Ac3OZQBb-uvAsfPyQ3erXHFcZrqKOCPIi9BTkWIWYhs-gvkDmlCMLEdr4abnoLSEL3xs8-fhPpe9t9V5YByhZUiw6gyq3rkkCbDJHv_Yn8Zr9dLOm7FQAoxW7vERVyxzoLjfjWKX50M1wZjJFogpJIai1_Eb52C3od7D4TcoMLpjX1NkMAmIqUz79itrlSjdXizE8viCWriz-QVosSWwztFdXwga-Qhh8nF2QeOPehSjzDJqRvdt9P1VDB0j2RkswtlKZ1zulyQpJwWj2sOWCcipZlExH8CemGrrOlinhEqcl/49p/SDiwFR2pQyidOIibfwa8uw/h3/h001.9gSopCSxDBdjiI4MCeKAQDGlvjYHxPT8NmRpMqYJce8)

**
## How we won in 2022
In 2022, Nevada pulled through in one of the toughest midterm election cycles for Democrats across the country. Despite the historic headwinds facing Silver State Democrats,
* we grew our majorities in the State Legislature,
* won all three frontline Congressional seats, and
* maintained Democratic control of the U.S. Senate by reelecting Catherine Cortez Masto by _less than 8,000 votes_.

Our coordinated campaign delivered a strong Get Out The Vote program knocking more than **1 million doors** , making nearly **4.5 million calls,** and sending more than _2 million texts_ to voters.
This winning field operation cost Democrats **_$15 million_** and we saved our majority in the Senate, but _we weren’t able to win every seat._ Republicans managed to flip the Governor’s mansion along with two other constitutional officer seats. **[_We need your help to power a truly grassroots operation, please chip in here to ensure we have the resources to win._](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yT0lhW6SUIBaDocFw1qIPk2ncdK2ZYzkOmTfT-On-pn90xwpuG6xMt0JDsYFPgJECIG4UhXkE1rY173L6oQF-wusroN0hQMlXt1bNsycTQLZLeIlvMXgjCNiKx06J5XZy11QO4-PEhbrgBRQwUinuVpFSvVziiAMZ_lXpu1E8QXpCJNBZeqHzQrr5RXD77KlWq18cbzhPSocvVYuYfYxt_vC9CVJNGDPyvctS3w9evxmZOCJhCm96RV3XAma8xwmcABEqfRnQkKlpY9yEWjdIlXVSHZ6FiMF6yh4CYZ0nMi9XCRpGKHVDWbAio7LIN7JgTCeJHKrJaBlWvaDo5z82M_ch5ONgYkFYe0e_ICXXI9x8eoghvhk8sJbvpoUvQ5dL6/49p/SDiwFR2pQyidOIibfwa8uw/h4/h001.IYRBGkhAH9lAhs1DZDNrJD7UJb84eBjpH3vjas-SO8Q)

**
## What we’re facing in 2024
With each cycle, Nevada's victory margins have been shrinking from Senator Harry Reid winning re-election in 2010 by _5%_ to Biden defeating Trump in 2020 by _2.5%_ to Senator Catherine Cortez Masto winning re-election last cycle by _less than a percentage point_.
Nevada is a must-win battleground for Democrats, with three House seats and Senator Jacky Rosen up for re-election, what happens here will determine Democratic control in Congress and the White House.
This cycle, we’ve seen a **_rise of nonpartisan voters_** outgrowing registered Democrats and Republicans. Reaching these voters is crucial and will be more challenging and more expensive.
Republicans see an opening in Nevada and will pour unprecedented amounts of money to flip the state red. Many self-funded Republican challengers for House and Senate seats are coming out with **_six-figure loans to themselves_** to narrow the playing field.
**_GOP megadonors like the Koch network are dumping millions in their effort to win Nevada._****_[_Chip in now to make sure we can fight back._](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yT0lhW6SUIBaDocFw1qIPk2ncdK2ZYzkOmTfT-On-pn90xwpuG6xMt0JDsYFPgJECIXwX1YWdqFtSkSFCcY-1gt2Oa6xtl3OjIC_BkUxsH6oB6T0IK9_Nid_0Hnmp2PRWI5pZNmNoTTeoCfYcuZcnhRyq2oTmkYotKB1E5y5Y36vYSk_UK6KWXOIDubyEtnKUWisobYN1C4Yk-AIOg86sH1oSsSzhHf25f1cenQho2X-_DB37wxlBmYj4dQk9DUT5qvj5G9TUF6MC5PSWuD9yWN3DUZGcDxd8Vlr-bPGNOWYrqVSU01_B1wL3kc6w6TsKUh2h9SYu8OfxM2UXh_9adlWZ_LQMEadux2KxH4jvt4dGGKrxbKoPS5-B5XEDvKWmN/49p/SDiwFR2pQyidOIibfwa8uw/h5/h001.e4mDodyvKXeaDN-_HnryV5wAKTQ_BrHW4ZHEpBbdBoY)_**
Latest polling shows it’s too close to call. _Cook Political Report_ called Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.

## What we need
We know we can win in November. We’ve done it before. In order to win, we need financial support to strengthen our State Party infrastructure to run a field operation that starkly differs from what we’ve done in previous cycles.
We need investment to run organizing programs that:
* connects with Nevada’s nonpartisan base of voters
* consistently engages core constituencies including Latino, Black, AAPI, and young Nevadans
* educate voters on Nevada’s new vote-by-mail system made permanent in 2022
* can test new tactics and pivot responsively and quickly to the ebb and flow of election conditions

## The Bottom Line
After coming within a percentage point of flipping a U.S. Senate seat and managing to turn the governor’s mansion red again in 2022, **_Republicans see an opening in Nevada._**
Fighting back is going to get even more expensive and if we’re to thwart any potential Republican gains in Nevada **_we need the resources, time and money, to build our winning ground game._******

clean_body: Trump has “a concept of a plan” but here's our actual plan to win back the House, keep the Senate, and elect the first-ever Madam President. | | | | This is a long email, there, but we put a lot of thought and planning into our campaign strategy memo. Trump has “ a concept of a plan ” but we have an actual plan to elect Kamala and elect a governing majority so that the things Americans want to see from federal protections for abortion, affordable housing, and gun safety legislation are all possible. CONFIDENTIAL MEMO: To: Top Supporters From: Hilary Barrett, Nevada State Democratic Party RE: In 2024, Nevada will once again be an expensive, hardfought battleground state \-------------------------------------- Election cycle after election cycle, Nevada remains an expensive and hardfought battleground state where candidates win or lose by razor-thin field margins. Nevada is a winnable battleground, but it requires a lot more work and investment because of the changing electorate. How we won in 2022 In 2022, Nevada pulled through in one of the toughest midterm election cycles for Democrats across the country. Despite the historic headwinds facing Silver State Democrats, we grew our majorities in the State Legislature, won all three frontline Congressional seats, and maintained Democratic control of the U.S. Senate by reelecting Catherine Cortez Masto by less than 8,000 votes. Our coordinated campaign delivered a strong Get Out The Vote program knocking more than 1 million doors , making nearly 4.5 million calls, and sending more than 2 million texts to voters. This winning field operation cost Democrats $15 million and we saved our majority in the Senate, but we weren’t able to win every seat. Republicans managed to flip the Governor’s mansion along with two other constitutional officer seats. What we’re facing in 2024 With each cycle, Nevada's victory margins have been shrinking from Senator Harry Reid winning re-election in 2010 by 5% to Biden defeating Trump in 2020 by 2.5% to Senator Catherine Cortez Masto winning re-election last cycle by less than a percentage point. Nevada is a must-win battleground for Democrats, with three House seats and Senator Jacky Rosen up for re-election, what happens here will determine Democratic control in Congress and the White House. This cycle, we’ve seen a rise of nonpartisan voters outgrowing registered Democrats and Republicans. Reaching these voters is crucial and will be more challenging and more expensive. Republicans see an opening in Nevada and will pour unprecedented amounts of money to flip the state red. Many self-funded Republican challengers for House and Senate seats are coming out with six-figure loans to themselves to narrow the playing field. GOP megadonors like the Koch network are dumping millions in their effort to win Nevada. Latest polling shows it’s too close to call. Cook Political Report called Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats. What we need We know we can win in November. We’ve done it before. In order to win, we need financial support to strengthen our State Party infrastructure to run a field operation that starkly differs from what we’ve done in previous cycles. We need investment to run organizing programs that: connects with Nevada’s nonpartisan base of voters consistently engages core constituencies including Latino, Black, AAPI, and young Nevadans educate voters on Nevada’s new vote-by-mail system made permanent in 2022 can test new tactics and pivot responsively and quickly to the ebb and flow of election conditions The Bottom Line After coming within a percentage point of flipping a U.S. Senate seat and managing to turn the governor’s mansion red again in 2022, Republicans see an opening in Nevada. Fighting back is going to get even more expensive and if we’re to thwart any potential Republican gains in Nevada we need the resources, time and money, to build our winning ground game.** Thanks for taking the time. I know that was a long email but now that you see the context of what we’re up against and what we need No matter the outcome, this election in Nevada is going to make history. There’s too much at stake to cede any ground — Republicans have made their agenda clear from cutting Medicare and Social Security, rolling back reproductive rights, undermining democracy, ignoring the climate crisis, and prioritizing anti-LGBTQ+ legislation. body:
Did you hear Kamala Harris’ answer on climate?!?

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=1)
---
Peter,

I’m afraid I’m not finished sharing debate highlights with you. This one deserved an email of its own.

Yesterday, anti-war activist Michael Prysner posted a question on X that frankly a lot of us were asking:
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=2)
---
Sadly, Michael, you were not dreaming.

In fact, Harris spent the first half of the debate reminding all of us just how much she loves fracking and fossil fuel extraction:
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=3)
---
But she really gave the game away when the moderators specifically asked her about her plan to address the climate emergency (the only question about this crisis during the entire debate, we should note).
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=4)
---
The vice president is not wrong. In fact the Biden-Harris administration HAS set historic records for fossil fuel extraction, all while boasting that they passed the largest climate bill in history.

**The real-world result of these destructive policies are not cheap shots fired at political opponents or snappy TV ads. It’s this.**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=5)
---
_Photo credit: Brandon Yoshizawa, landscape photographer, Los Angeles._
---
That’s a wildfire currently ravaging the hills beyond Los Angeles, spanning 13,000 acres and threatening thousands of homes and businesses.

Harris attacked Donald Trump on Tuesday night for believing that climate change is a hoax, yet she continues to pursue the policies that are making it worse. What else can we say to that but “What the frack?!”

**[If you want a president with a clear, decades-long record confronting climate change, then please contribute to our campaign today. We’re still battling Democrats suing to kick us off the ballot so that we can guarantee every American has the opportunity to vote for the only pro-planet, pro-peace, pro-worker campaign in this race, and we need your help.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=6)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=7 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=what_the_frack&n=7)
---
The consequences of Harris’ climate annihilation will only continue to grow, threatening our livelihoods, wiping out our shelter and food supply and – sooner than you may think – our survival as a species.

What we saw on Tuesday were two candidates striving to outbid the other’s promises to push us towards a new world war and accelerate the climate emergency.

**We deserve better. In fact, our survival demands that we make better choices at the ballot box.

** In solidarity,

Jill
---
